Then go straight to the main methodology section: task set and simulated users, trajectory review protocol, quality index, side-by-side reviews, reliability and bias checks, and the nightly production pipeline. In the results section, prioritize qualitative examples and the correlation study to see whether AgentLens measures something genuinely different from public coding-agent benchmarks. If your interest is training feedback loops, pay close attention to how structured the review rubric is and whether it could be converted into preference data, process rewards, or regression labels. About 20 to 30 minutes should be enough for the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 看评测 rubric 和 judge 一致性就够；二值 pass/fail 确实太粗，但 LLM review 若无校准会把噪声包装成诊断。
recommendation.en: Skim the rubric and judge-agreement analysis; binary pass/fail is too coarse, but uncalibrated LLM reviews can turn noise into diagnosis.

paper.title: PolyWorkBench: Benchmarking Multilingual Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong performance in long-horizon tasks that require planning, tool use, and interaction with external environments. However, most existing benchmarks implicitly assume a monolingual setting, where the entire execution process, including reasoning, tool invocation, and output generation, is conducted within a single language. In contrast, real-world applications often involve multilingual inputs and outputs within a unified workflow, yet the interact

summary.core_problem: 解决现有长程 agent benchmark 默认单语执行，无法评估真实工作流中多语言输入、推理、工具调用和输出交织带来的能力缺口。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 multilingual long-horizon agent benchmark。对 agent 评测设计有价值，也能给多语种工具使用和轨迹监督提供数据视角，但与 LLM 基座预训练的直接联系有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PolyWorkBench，覆盖 commerce、knowledge work、legal analysis、localization、manufacturing 五类工作流，共 67 个任务；任务要求处理异构多语输入、迭代推理、调用外部工具并生成结构化输出，重点考察多语环境下的长程执行。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参评模型名单和具体分数。预期实验会比较多种 LLM agent 在单语与多语工作流中的性能差异，并分析语言切换对规划、工具调用和错误累积的影响。作为 benchmark，其价值主要在任务构造而非模型方法。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the gap that existing long-horizon agent benchmarks assume monolingual execution and therefore miss failures arising from multilingual inputs, reasoning, tool use, and outputs within one workflow.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a multilingual long-horizon agent benchmark. It is useful for agent evaluation design and may inform multilingual tool-use supervision, but it is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PolyWorkBench, spanning 67 tasks across commerce, knowledge work, legal analysis, localization, and manufacturing. Tasks require heterogeneous multilingual inputs, iterative reasoning, external tool use, and structured outputs, explicitly targeting multilingual agent execution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list evaluated models or exact scores. The likely evaluation compares multiple LLM agents under monolingual versus multilingual workflows and analyzes how language switching affects planning, tool invocation, and error accumulation. Its value lies primarily in task design rather than a new model method.

recommendation.zh: 做 agent eval 的可以收下，但对 pretrain 研究员只需知道一个事实：多语工具链会引入新的长程误差源，读任务设计和失败类型就够了。
recommendation.en: Useful if you track agent evals, but for pretraining the only takeaway is that multilingual tool chains create new long-horizon failure modes; skim the task design and error taxonomy.

paper.title: AgenticDataBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Data Agents
paper.abstract: Data science aims to derive actionable insights from heterogeneous raw data, unlocking the value of the massive amounts of data generated in modern society. Automating this process is essential to reducing labor-intensive efforts for data scientists and enabling scalable data-driven applications. Recently, large language model (LLM)-based data agents have emerged as a promising solution to automate data science workflows. However, the field lacks comprehensive benchmarks to rigorously evaluate t

summary.core_problem: 构建一个覆盖数据科学工作流的 LLM data agent 评测基准，解决现有评测缺少多场景、细粒度 ground truth 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark。它面向 data agent，而不是单一 SQL、表格问答或可视化任务，试图覆盖从原始异构数据到分析结论的完整数据科学流程。
summary.technical_approach: AgenticDataBench 收集真实数据集和任务，覆盖 15 个垂直领域，并提供细粒度标注，用于评估 agent 在不同数据处理、分析和决策步骤中的表现。摘要提到包含 5 个真实 B2B 用例，强调任务来源和标注粒度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、agent baseline、榜单结果或分项指标。可确认的是 benchmark 包含多领域真实任务和细粒度 ground-truth labels，用于系统评估 LLM-based data agents。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for LLM-based data agents across data science workflows, addressing the lack of diverse and fine-grained evaluation assets.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. It targets data agents beyond isolated SQL, table QA, or visualization tasks, aiming to evaluate realistic end-to-end data science scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgenticDataBench collects real datasets and tasks across 15 vertical domains and provides fine-grained ground-truth labels. The abstract mentions five real-world B2B use cases and emphasizes coverage of heterogeneous scenarios and detailed task-level evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model baselines, leaderboard results, or metric numbers. The confirmed asset is a multi-domain benchmark with realistic tasks and fine-grained labels for evaluating LLM-based data agents.

recommendation.zh: 这是 data-agent 评测资产，不会改变 pretrain prior；若做工具调用评测，扫任务 taxonomy 即可。
recommendation.en: This is a data-agent evaluation asset, not a pretraining signal; skim the task taxonomy only if tool-use evaluation is on your plate.

paper.title: OSWorld2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks
paper.abstract: Existing computer-use benchmarks fail to capture the realism, complexity, and long-horizon demands of real-world computer use, limiting their ability to reveal the limitations of frontier agents. We introduce OSWorld 2.0, a benchmark of 108 long-horizon computer-use workflows across everyday and professional tasks, designed to capture complex and challenging real-world phenomena. Each task represents a realistic end-to-end workflow that takes human users a median of about 1.6 hours to complete a

summary.core_problem: 现有电脑使用Agent基准的任务时长短、场景窄，多为单应用、孤立子任务，无法覆盖真实工作流的长时程、跨应用、步骤相互依赖、环境动态变化等核心特征，导致前沿Agent在旧基准上的高分高估了实际部署能力。该工作构建了更贴近真实场景的长时程电脑使用基准。
summary.importance: 多模态基座与通用Agent基座的能力评测、对齐数据（SFT/RL轨迹）构建均依赖电脑使用基准。现有基准的简化任务设置会掩盖基座在长时程规划、状态跟踪、错误修复等核心能力上的缺陷。OSWorld2.0提供了更严格的评测资产与真实工作流轨迹数据，可引导Agent导向的基座预训练与对齐向真实需求优化。
summary.technical_approach: 构建108个长时程真实电脑使用任务，遵循三个设计原则：1）真实工作流：任务来自专业场景的专家访谈与标注员调研，输入素材采用真实材料而非合成生成；2）长时程结构：难度来自跨多个应用的相互依赖步骤，而非任务重复或无关子任务拼接；3）多样挑战现象：每个任务标注10类能力维度（跨源推理、隐状态推断、冲突消歧、动态环境适应等）。具体实现上，自托管31个任务相关的web服务（邮件、银行、团队聊天等）以控制状态可评分；基于连贯的有状态用户配置初始化任务；注入任务中消息模拟动态环境；提供带有限知识的模拟用户；评分采用细粒度功能性检查点（平均每任务27.25个）而非模型打分；所有任务通过单元测试、人工重解、前沿Agent rollout审计，避免奖励黑客与假阴性问题。
summary.experiments: 任务统计显示，人类完成任务的中位数时长为1.6小时（是OSWorld1.0的48倍），Claude Opus4.7最大思考模式下平均每任务需318次工具调用（OSWorld1.0约为30次）。对Claude Opus4.8/4.7、GPT-5.5、主流开源模型在150/300/500步预算下的评测显示，最强配置（Claude Opus4.8+最大思考+批量工具调用）的严格二分类完成率仅为20.6%，部分完成分为54.8%；token效率最高的GPT-5.5完成率约为13%，token消耗不到Opus的1/5。长时程任务的完成率随时长增加暴跌至接近0，但部分完成分仍保持较高水平；人类认为简单的任务对Agent仍存在较高难度。能力缺陷分析显示，Agent的弱点集中在隐状态推断、多项目状态跟踪、冲突消歧、动态环境适应，且用于错误修复的预算占比不到7%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：首先阅读引言部分，了解现有基准的核心缺陷与OSWorld2.0的三个设计原则；随后查看第二节的任务构建标准与环境设计要点；再浏览评测部分的核心性能数据与能力缺口分析。无需深入附录中的具体任务细节，除非需要开展Agent评测或对齐数据构建工作。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing computer-use agent benchmarks rely on short, narrow, single-application tasks with isolated subtasks, which fail to capture core features of real-world workflows: long horizon, cross-application dependencies, and dynamic environments. This leads to inflated frontier agent scores that do not reflect real deployment capability. A long-horizon computer-use benchmark aligned with real scenarios is constructed to address this gap.
summary_en.importance: Multimodal base models and general-purpose agent bases depend on computer-use benchmarks for capability evaluation and alignment data (SFT/RL trajectory) curation. The simplified task setup of prior benchmarks hides critical weaknesses of base models in long-horizon planning, state tracking, and error recovery. OSWorld 2.0 provides stricter evaluation assets and realistic workflow trajectory data that can guide pre-training and alignment of agent-oriented base models toward real-world requirements.
summary_en.technical_approach: 108 long-horizon real-world computer-use tasks are built following three design principles: 1) Authentic workflows: tasks are sourced from expert interviews and annotator research on real professional scenarios, with input artifacts adapted from real materials instead of synthetic generation; 2) Long-horizon structure: difficulty comes from interdependent steps across multiple applications, rather than task repetition or concatenation of unrelated subtasks; 3) Diverse challenge phenomena: each task is annotated with 10 capability dimensions (cross-source reasoning, implicit-state inference, conflict disambiguation, dynamic environment adaptation, etc.). For implementation, 31 task-facing web services (email, banking, team chat, etc.) are self-hosted to enable controlled, scorable states; tasks are initialized from coherent stateful user profiles; mid-task messages are injected to simulate dynamic environments; a simulated user with bounded knowledge is provided; scoring relies on fine-grained functional checkpoints (average 27.25 per task) instead of model-based judgment. All tasks are audited via unit tests, human re-solving, and frontier agent rollouts to prevent reward hacking and false negatives.
summary_en.experiments: Task statistics show a median human completion time of 1.6 hours (48× longer than OSWorld 1.0) and an average of 318 tool calls per task for Claude Opus 4.7 with maximum thinking (vs. ~30 in OSWorld 1.0). Evaluations of Claude Opus 4.8/4.7, GPT-5.5, and leading open-source models under 150/300/500 step budgets find that the strongest configuration (Claude Opus 4.8 + maximum thinking + batched tool calls) reaches only 20.6% strict binary completion rate and 54.8% partial score. GPT-5.5, the most token-efficient model, achieves ~13% completion rate with less than 1/5 of Opus's token consumption. Completion rate drops to near zero on the longest workflows despite high partial scores, and tasks rated easy by humans remain challenging for agents. Capability gap analysis shows weaknesses concentrate on implicit-state inference, multi-item state tracking, conflict disambiguation, and dynamic environment adaptation, with agents allocating less than 7% of their budget to error recovery.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction first for core limitations of prior benchmarks and three design principles of OSWorld 2.0. Then review task construction standards and environment design in Section 2, followed by key performance results and capability gap analysis in the evaluation section. Skip detailed task descriptions in appendices unless working on agent benchmarking or alignment data curation. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不改预训练 recipe，但会改你评估 Agent 的 prior：只看任务成功率不够，318 步级别的失败分布更像真实产品问题。
recommendation.en: This will not change a pretraining recipe, but it should change the evaluation prior: success rate on short tasks misses the failure modes that appear around 300 tool calls.

paper.title: TUA-Bench: A Benchmark for General-Purpose Terminal-Use Agents
paper.abstract: As large language models and harness frameworks continue to advance, agents operating in terminals are increasingly capable of performing a broader range of general computer-use tasks beyond coding. However, existing benchmarks do not adequately evaluate general-purpose terminal computer-use agents (TUAs): general computer-use benchmarks primarily target graphical user interfaces (GUIs), whereas terminal-based benchmarks largely emphasize technical and programming-centric workflows historically

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是通用 terminal-use agent 的评测缺口：现有 GUI computer-use benchmark 混入了视觉定位和界面感知难题，而已有 terminal benchmark 又偏软件工程和 shell 原生技术任务，难以评估更一般的命令行数字工作能力。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产类工作，对预训练本身没有直接训练配方贡献，但对 agent 能力评估有实际参考价值。它把终端看作更适合语言模型的计算机接口：状态、动作和反馈大多是文本形式，能更干净地测量规划、工具调用、执行监控和错误恢复。对基座研究的启发在于，agentic capability 评测可以减少视觉 grounding 干扰，把长程任务能力和工具使用能力拆得更清楚。
summary.technical_approach: TUA-Bench 包含 120 个真实任务，覆盖五类任务，从文档编辑、邮件管理、实时网页信息查找、媒体处理，到生物、医学物理、建筑工程、机械工程等专家工作流。任务从 394 个候选中筛选和修订，去掉指令含糊、过于简单、输入输出不一致的样本。每个任务配有标准化描述、可执行环境和验证程序，并构建在 Harbor 框架之上，以保证复现和自动评分。设计重点是让 agent 通过 CLI 完成任务，而不是通过 GUI 截图和坐标操作完成任务，因此评估更偏向文本原生工具使用、文件操作、脚本组合和结果核验。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了多个前沿模型和 agent harness，并做了 reasoning effort 消融。最强被测 agent 达到 65.8% success rate，说明这类任务还远未被完全解决。错误主要集中在长程计划不稳、工具选择不当、命令执行后缺少检查、遇到异常时恢复能力弱，以及对任务完成条件的验证不足。这个数字比单纯看命令生成能力更有信息量，因为 TUA-Bench 要求 agent 在真实环境中连续操作并提交可验证结果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 40 分钟。优先看 benchmark 构造流程、五类任务的定义、环境与 verifier 设计、评分协议，以及模型对比和 reasoning effort 消融。对预训练研究者而言，最值得关注的是任务失败分析：它能提示哪些能力可能需要在 mid-training、tool-use SFT 或 RL 环节加强，例如执行后自检、错误恢复和多步状态跟踪。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a gap in evaluating general-purpose terminal-use agents. GUI computer-use benchmarks partly measure visual grounding and coordinate control, while existing terminal benchmarks are mostly centered on programming and shell-native technical work.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution, not a pretraining-method paper. Its value for foundation-model research is that the terminal provides a text-native interface for computer use: actions, state, logs, and feedback are mostly textual. That makes it easier to isolate planning, tool use, execution monitoring, and recovery from the visual perception burden of GUI environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: TUA-Bench contains 120 curated tasks across five task families. The tasks cover everyday digital work, such as document editing, email management, live web information seeking, and media processing, as well as expert workflows designed with domain specialists in biology, medical physics, architectural engineering, and mechanical engineering. The final set is selected from 394 candidates after removing or revising ambiguous, trivial, or inconsistent tasks. Each task has a standardized specification, an executable environment, and an automatic verification procedure. The benchmark is built on Harbor, with the goal of making terminal-agent evaluation reproducible and less dependent on GUI perception.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate frontier models and agent frameworks, including ablations over reasoning effort. The best evaluated agent reaches 65.8% success rate. The remaining failures point to weaknesses in long-horizon planning, choosing and composing tools, monitoring command outputs, recovering from errors, and verifying that the final artifact satisfies the instruction. The benchmark therefore measures more than command syntax generation; it tests whether an agent can carry out a complete workflow in a live environment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Read the task construction process, the five task-family definitions, the environment and verifier design, the scoring protocol, and the model comparison with reasoning-effort ablations. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful part is the failure analysis, especially cases involving missing self-checks, poor recovery, and weak multi-step state tracking.

recommendation.zh: Terminal agent 方向的有用基准，但更偏 agent/评测，预训练研究员扫一下任务设计和 failure mode 即可。
recommendation.en: Useful terminal-agent benchmark, but squarely in agent/eval territory; pretraining folks can skim task design and failure modes, skip deep dives.

paper.title: SpreadsheetBench 2: Evaluating Agents on End-to-End Business Spreadsheet Workflows
paper.abstract: Spreadsheets are widely used for business analysis, financial modeling, reporting, and decision-making. However, most existing spreadsheet benchmarks evaluate isolated operations such as single-formula generation or local cell edits, and therefore fail to capture end-to-end workflows in realistic business settings. We introduce \textsc{SpreadsheetBench 2}, a workflow-level benchmark for spreadsheet agents that covers three task categories: generation, debugging, and visualization. The benchmark

summary.core_problem: 现有的电子表格 Agent 评测基准多局限于单一操作（如单公式生成或局部单元格修改），无法反映真实商业场景中包含跨表依赖、多步协调的端到端工作流。
summary.importance: 提出了一个贴近真实商业工作流的电子表格 Agent 评测基准 SpreadsheetBench 2，将评测粒度从“孤立操作”提升到“端到端任务”，暴露了当前 LLM 在长上下文推理和多步规划上的严重不足。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了包含 321 个任务的基准，分为生成（财务建模/模板补全）、调试和可视化三大类。数据源自真实财务报告和企业文件，由专家标注。任务具有复杂的跨表结构和大量修改需求（平均 11.8 个工作表，593.5 次单元格修改）。采用统一的多轮 Agent 框架（基于 SWE-agent），通过命令行接口与电子表格交互，并对比了不同 Agent 框架（如通用代码 Agent）对端到端性能的影响。
summary.experiments: 评测了 8 个 SOTA LLM 和多个基于 LLM 的电子表格产品。结果显示，所有模型的整体准确率均低于 35%，在调试任务上表现尤为糟糕。错误分析表明，主要失败原因在于对目标单元格的检查不足和选择错误。消融实验发现，针对电子表格优化的 SWE-agent 框架在任务级准确率上显著优于通用代码 Agent 框架。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Introduction 中对现有基准局限性的分析，以及 SpreadsheetBench 2 章节中关于任务分类（生成、调试、可视化）和数据构建的细节。实验部分关注不同模型在三大类任务上的表现差异，以及 Agent 框架对性能的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing spreadsheet agent benchmarks focus on isolated operations (e.g., single-formula generation or local cell edits), failing to capture end-to-end workflows with cross-sheet dependencies and multi-step coordination in realistic business settings.
summary_en.importance: Introduces SpreadsheetBench 2, a workflow-level benchmark that shifts the evaluation paradigm from isolated operations to end-to-end tasks, revealing severe limitations of current LLMs in long-context reasoning and multi-step planning within spreadsheet environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a benchmark of 321 tasks categorized into generation (financial modeling/template completion), debugging, and visualization. Data is sourced from authentic financial reports and corporate filings, annotated by experts. Tasks involve complex multi-sheet structures and substantial modifications (averaging 11.8 worksheets and 593.5 cell modifications per instance). Evaluates models under a unified multi-turn agent scaffold (based on SWE-agent) interacting via a CLI, and compares the impact of different agent scaffolds (e.g., general-purpose coding agents) on end-to-end performance.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 8 SOTA LLMs and several LLM-based spreadsheet products. Results show overall accuracy remains below 35% across all models, with particularly poor performance on debugging tasks. Error analysis indicates failures are primarily driven by insufficient inspection and incorrect selection of target cells. Ablation studies reveal that the spreadsheet-optimized SWE-agent scaffold significantly outperforms general-purpose coding agent scaffolds in task-level accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the critique of existing benchmarks, and the SpreadsheetBench 2 section for details on task categorization (generation, debugging, visualization) and data construction. In the experiments, pay attention to the performance gap across task categories and the impact of the agent scaffold.

recommendation.zh: 长链路多依赖agent评测的干净benchmark，只看任务构建方法与附录的失败模式分析即可。
recommendation.en: Clean benchmark for long-horizon multi-dependency agent evaluation; read only task construction methodology and failure mode analysis in the appendix.

paper.title: Beyond Function Calling: Benchmarking Tool-Using Agents under Tool-Environment Unreliability
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that solve tasks by interacting with external tool environments. Although recent tool-use benchmarks increasingly cover complex task settings, they still largely assume clean, stable, and trustworthy tool environments, leaving tool-environment unreliability insufficiently examined. We introduce ToolBench-X, a benchmark for evaluating agents under recoverable reliability hazards. ToolBench-X contains executable multi-step tasks across dive

summary.core_problem: 现有工具调用评测大多假设工具环境稳定、接口文档可信、返回值规范。ToolBench-X 关注更接近真实系统的问题：当工具存在可恢复的不可靠性时，Agent 是否还能完成多步任务，而不只是生成正确的函数名和参数。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 Agent 能力评测有参考价值。它把工具使用失败拆成可控的环境不可靠性，而不是只看 function calling accuracy。这有助于区分模型的调用能力、错误诊断能力、证据校验能力和恢复策略能力。对后训练和推理时扩展也有启发：很多失败不是任务不可解，而是模型没有正确识别异常、没有复核中间证据，或过早给出答案。
summary.technical_approach: ToolBench-X 构造了 1106 个可执行多步任务和 4956 个 Python 工具，覆盖顺序、并行、混合三类工作流。每个任务有确定性工具和标准最终答案，支持自动执行和 exact-match 评测。核心设计是从干净工具环境出发，系统注入五类 reliability hazards：Specification Drift、Invocation Error、Execution Failure、Output Drift、Cross-Source Conflict。注入的错误必须是 disruptive 但 recoverable，即会干扰模型，但任务仍保留至少一条可行恢复路径，例如重试、fallback、交叉验证、输出归一化、证据补全。这个设计区别于简单的工具破坏或噪声注入，因为它评估的是恢复能力，而不是把任务变成不可解。
summary.experiments: 基准规模为 1106 tasks / 4956 tools。与 BFCL、ToolBench、τ-bench、T-EVAL、UltraTool、AgentNoiseBench 等相比，ToolBench-X 同时覆盖五类工具环境不可靠性，并包含顺序、并行、混合工具流。实验结论是当前被测模型在可靠性 hazard 下整体脆弱，所有模型成功率均低于 60%。作者还测试了 targeted hints 和 failure-triggered test-time scaling：当模型遇到困难时提供针对性提示，或允许模型基于失败反馈进行额外反思和多轮推理，任务完成率会明显提升。这说明一部分失败可以通过更好的诊断和推理预算缓解。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对工具环境不可靠性的定义，Table 1 中与已有工具评测的差异，以及 benchmark construction / hazard taxonomy 部分。实验部分主要看不同 hazard 下的失败模式、hint 的增益、failure-triggered test-time scaling 的设置。对预训练研究者更有价值的是错误类型设计和自动评测协议，而不是具体排行榜数字。

summary_en.core_problem: Most tool-use benchmarks assume clean APIs, stable documentation, and trustworthy outputs. ToolBench-X evaluates a harder and more realistic setting: whether an agent can finish multi-step tasks when the tool environment contains recoverable reliability hazards, not merely whether it can emit the right function call.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a direct contribution to pretraining, but it is useful for evaluating agent robustness. It separates function-call correctness from failure diagnosis, evidence verification, and recovery behavior. This distinction matters for post-training and inference-time scaling: many failures are not caused by unsolvable tasks, but by the model trusting suspicious observations, failing to cross-check evidence, or stopping before the required information is complete.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolBench-X contains 1,106 executable multi-step tasks and 4,956 Python tools, covering sequential, parallel, and mixed workflows. Each task has deterministic tools and a canonical final answer, enabling automatic execution and exact-match evaluation. Starting from clean environments, the benchmark injects five structured hazard types: specification drift, invocation errors, execution failures, output drift, and cross-source conflicts. A key design constraint is recoverability. The injected hazards should disrupt the agent, but every task should still preserve at least one viable recovery path, such as retrying, falling back to another tool, normalizing outputs, cross-checking sources, or verifying incomplete evidence. This makes the benchmark different from simple API corruption or random noise injection.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark scale is 1,106 tasks and 4,956 tools. Compared with BFCL, ToolBench, τ-bench, T-EVAL, UltraTool, and AgentNoiseBench, ToolBench-X jointly covers five forms of tool-environment unreliability and supports sequential, parallel, and mixed tool-use workflows. The evaluated models remain fragile under these hazards, with all reported success rates below 60%. Targeted hints substantially improve task completion when the model gets stuck. Failure-triggered test-time scaling, where the model reflects on failed attempts and spends additional reasoning rounds, also improves performance. These results suggest that better diagnosis and recovery policies can recover a nontrivial fraction of failures.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the motivation in the introduction, Table 1 for the benchmark comparison, and the sections defining the hazard taxonomy and benchmark construction. In the experiments, look at per-hazard failure patterns, the effect of targeted hints, and the failure-triggered test-time scaling setup. For pretraining researchers, the main value is the taxonomy and evaluation protocol rather than the absolute leaderboard numbers.

recommendation.zh: Agent 评测里这个 setup 比普通 function-calling 更干净；看 hazard taxonomy 和 recovery-path 标注即可。
recommendation.en: This setup is cleaner than ordinary function-calling benchmarks; read the hazard taxonomy and recovery-path construction.

paper.title: ChainWorld: Composing Long-Horizon Desktop Workloads from Atomic OSWorld Tasks
paper.abstract: Computer use agents are evaluated almost exclusively on atomic desktop tasks, but realistic desktop work requires sustaining state across multiple objectives. We study this gap with ChainWorld, which composes atomic OSWorld tasks into long horizon desktop workloads through directional compatibility search while preserving the source evaluators. The resulting workload contains 347 chains of length two to four and compares two renderings of the same task sequence. In single turn evaluation, all ta

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是桌面 computer-use agent 评测过短的问题。现有 OSWorld 等基准多是单个原子任务，能测界面感知和短程操作，但很难测跨任务状态保持、未完成目标追踪、应用切换和长程执行可靠性。ChainWorld 的目标是在不重写评测器的前提下，把已有原子任务组合成长一些的工作流。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练的直接价值有限，更偏 agent evaluation 和 post-train 评测资产。启发点在于：单任务成功率不能代表长程桌面执行能力，评测数据的组合方式会显著改变模型表现。对于做 agent SFT/RL 或通用操作系统代理训练的人，它提供了一个较干净的长程评测构造方法：复用已有任务、保留已有 evaluator、显式控制可执行性和状态依赖。这类信号可用于判断模型是否真的学会持续执行，而不是只会完成孤立指令。
summary.technical_approach: ChainWorld 把 OSWorld 任务视为有向兼容图中的节点。每个任务先被解析成确定性的 profile，包括应用、相关应用、snapshot、指令、setup actions、文件和窗口写入、破坏性操作、evaluator 结构与读取对象，以及是否是 terminal-only。然后用方向性兼容规则搜索可串联任务，保证后一个任务能从前一个任务的最终状态合理开始。质量控制分三层：兼容性规则保证可执行连续性，完整链验证保证原有 evaluator 在最终状态仍然有效，tuple-level LLM judge 判断多个任务合在一起是否像一个连贯桌面会话。这个设计避免了纯手写长任务成本高的问题，也避免了完全自由生成任务时 evaluator 失效和执行不可控的问题。
summary.experiments: 论文从 OSWorld 的 369 个任务出发，排除了 8 个 Google Drive 任务，构造了 347 条长度为 2 到 4 的链式 workload。评测包含两种呈现方式：single-turn 一次性给出整条任务链；multi-turn 按任务逐步揭示。四个当前 computer-use agent 的最高链完成率只有 31%。multi-turn 对三个模型有提升，但整体仍然困难，说明把任务拆开给并不能消除长程执行问题。论文还报告，在最终 320 个失败样本的人工编码中，runtime 和 setup 失败只占 3%，支持这些组合任务的可执行性。结果也显示 aggregate score 会掩盖不同链结构和不同呈现协议下的失败模式。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 atomic task 和 long-horizon workload 差异的定义，判断这个 benchmark 是否符合自己的 agent 研究问题。Methodology 是重点，尤其是 task profile、directional compatibility graph、三层质量控制和 LLM judge 预算分配。实验部分重点看 single-turn 与 multi-turn 的 paired comparison，以及按链长度、应用跨度、失败类型拆开的分析。若只关心预训练，可快速浏览；若在做 desktop agent post-training 或 RL evaluation，建议细看构造约束，因为这些约束决定了评测信号是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a gap in desktop agent evaluation: most benchmarks test one atomic task at a time, while realistic computer use requires maintaining state across multiple objectives and applications. ChainWorld asks whether existing OSWorld tasks can be composed into longer workloads without losing executability or invalidating the original evaluators.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent evaluation paper, not a pretraining method paper. Its value for LLM researchers is in the evaluation signal: atomic task success does not reliably predict long-horizon desktop behavior. For teams training computer-use agents with SFT or RL, the paper offers a controlled way to stress persistence, cross-task state management, and protocol sensitivity while reusing existing benchmark infrastructure.
summary_en.technical_approach: ChainWorld constructs a directed compatibility graph over OSWorld tasks. Each task is represented by a deterministic profile containing application metadata, snapshot information, instruction text, setup actions, file and window writes, destructive operations, evaluator reads, and terminal-only status. Candidate chains are searched under explicit structural constraints. The quality pipeline separates three requirements: executable continuity through compatibility rules, evaluator validity through full-chain validation, and session coherence through tuple-level LLM judging. This is a middle path between manual long-task authoring and free-form synthetic generation: it scales with the source task pool while keeping evaluator semantics auditable.
summary_en.experiments: Starting from 369 OSWorld tasks and excluding 8 Google Drive tasks, the authors build 347 chains of length two to four. The same chain is evaluated under two renderings: single-turn, where all objectives are given at once, and multi-turn, where objectives are revealed one by one. Across four current computer-use agents, the best chain completion rate is 31%. Multi-turn improves completion for three models, but performance remains low. In a coded sample of 320 failures, runtime and setup issues account for only 3%, suggesting that the benchmark mostly measures agent behavior rather than broken task construction. The results also show that aggregate completion hides differences by workload structure and presentation protocol.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Read the motivation in the introduction to understand why atomic desktop tasks are insufficient. Spend most of the time on the methodology: task profiles, directed compatibility search, evaluator-preserving validation, and coherence judging. In the results, focus on the paired single-turn versus multi-turn comparison and the breakdowns by workload structure and failure mode. For pretraining-only interests, a quick skim is enough. For desktop-agent post-training or RL evaluation, the construction constraints deserve closer reading because they determine whether the benchmark signal is dependable.

recommendation.zh: 长时程桌面Agent的核心评测基准，两种协议的失败模式分解可直接指导预训练中状态保持与长程推理能力的消融实验，重点看Table 4的失败归因。
recommendation.en: Core benchmark for long-horizon desktop agents; the failure mode breakdown across two protocols directly informs ablation of state retention and long-range reasoning capabilities in pretraining, focus on failure attribution in Table 4.

paper.title: PlanBench-XL: Evaluating Long-Horizon Planning of LLM Tool-Use Agents in Large-Scale Tool Ecosystems
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate in large tool ecosystems, where real-world tasks require discovering relevant tools, inferring implicit sub-goals, and adapting to dynamic environments over long horizons. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate planning under retrieval-limited tool visibility. To address this gap, we introduce PlanBench-XL, an interactive benchmark of 327 retail tasks over 1,665 tools that tests whether agents can iteratively retrieve usable tools, invoke them to uncover int

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文提出 PlanBench-XL，用来评测 LLM tool-use agent 在大型工具生态中的长程规划能力。它关注的不是单个 API 调用是否正确，而是 agent 在只能看到检索到的一小部分工具时，能否逐步发现相关工具、形成隐含子目标、调用工具获得中间证据，并在关键工具缺失、失败或误导时重新规划。
summary.importance: 它属于 agent 评测工作，对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 和 agent RL 环境有参考价值。现有很多工具使用评测给定完整工具集，或者把中间目标写得很清楚，这会低估真实工具生态中的难度。PlanBench-XL 把问题改成检索介导的部分可观测规划，更接近企业 MCP、软件 API 和大型平台工具环境。对训练研究的启发在于：tool-use agent 的失败不只来自模型不会调用函数，还来自工具检索、子目标发现、路径中断检测和恢复规划之间的耦合。
summary.technical_approach: PlanBench-XL 构造了一个零售场景下的交互式工具使用基准，包含 327 个任务实例和 1,665 个工具，平均每个任务约 25 轮交互。agent 不能一次看到完整工具列表，而是通过 retriever 在大工具空间中逐步检索候选工具。基准设计强调 bi-directional anticipation：一方面从已有证据向前探索，寻找下一步可用工具；另一方面从目标结果向后推断需要哪些中间状态或工具，再尝试桥接当前状态与目标状态。环境包含默认噪声工具，某些工具描述或返回会表明其可能不相关、过期或错误。除此之外，论文设计了可选 block mode，在检索时替换或破坏路径关键工具，并保持任务仍然可解，从而测试 agent 是否能识别当前路径失效并寻找替代路径。论文还描述了一个可扩展的 LLM-based task generator，用于生成 grounded queries 及其配套工具生态。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了 10 个开源和闭源前沿模型。总体结果显示，大规模工具生态中的长程规划仍然困难。在默认设置下，多数模型准确率低于三分之二；加入 retrieval-time blocking 后性能显著下降。文中报告 GPT-5.4 在只保留一条可行路径时降到约 30%，在只保留最长恢复路径时略高于 10%。误差分析强调，成功不仅需要广泛探索工具空间，还需要精确利用已经发现的信息，并稳定调用工具。换言之，增加检索次数并不自动带来成功；如果模型不能把中间证据转化成新的查询意图，或不能意识到某条路径已被阻断，长程任务会很快失败。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 benchmark construction、retrieval-mediated tool visibility、blocker module 和实验分析。Table 1 可用于快速了解它和已有工具评测的区别。Figure 1 有助于理解工具生态、retriever 和交互环境之间的关系。实验部分建议关注默认模式与 block mode 的性能差异，以及作者对 exploration、exploitation、tool invocation 三类失败的拆分。若目标是构建 agent RL 训练环境，可以进一步看任务生成器和阻断机制；若只关心 LLM 预训练，可快速扫过。

summary_en.core_problem: PlanBench-XL evaluates whether LLM tool-use agents can plan over long horizons in a large tool ecosystem when only retrieved subsets of tools are visible. The benchmark stresses iterative tool discovery, implicit subgoal formation, intermediate evidence gathering, and recovery when plausible tool paths fail.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent evaluation paper, not a core pretraining paper. Its value for LLM research is in the post-training and RL environment design side. Many tool-use benchmarks expose a fixed tool set or provide clear intermediate goals, which hides the difficulty of partial observability in real tool ecosystems. PlanBench-XL makes tool use retrieval-mediated: the agent must search for tools, use outputs to form new retrieval intents, and adapt when path-critical tools are missing, failing, or distracting. This helps diagnose whether failures come from planning, retrieval, evidence use, or tool invocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is an interactive retail-domain environment with 327 tasks and 1,665 tools. Each task requires about 25 turns on average. Agents do not receive the full tool inventory; they retrieve candidate tools from a large tool space at each step. The design supports bidirectional anticipation. Forward anticipation means searching from currently accumulated evidence toward the next useful action. Backward anticipation means reasoning from the desired final outcome to hypothesized intermediate states and tools. The environment includes default noisy tools whose descriptions or outputs may be irrelevant, stale, or erroneous. An optional blocking mode adds retrieval-time disruption by replacing or disabling path-critical tools while preserving at least one feasible solution path. The paper also describes a scalable LLM-based task generator that creates grounded user queries and paired tool ecosystems.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates ten leading open and proprietary LLMs. Performance remains limited even without blocking: most models are below two-thirds accuracy in the default setting. Blocking causes a large degradation. GPT-5.4 drops to around 30% when only one feasible path remains, and to slightly above 10% when only the longest recovery path is preserved. The analysis suggests that successful agents need more than broad exploration. They must exploit discovered evidence precisely, invoke tools reliably, and detect when a current plan has become invalid. More retrieval alone is insufficient if the model cannot convert intermediate observations into the next useful search or re-plan after failure.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the benchmark construction, the retrieval-mediated visibility setup, the blocker design, and the error analysis. Table 1 is useful for positioning the benchmark relative to prior tool-use evaluations. Figure 1 explains the interaction loop among the tool ecosystem, retriever, and agent. The most relevant experimental results are the default-versus-blocking comparisons and the breakdown of failures into exploration, exploitation, and tool invocation. For agent RL environment design, the task generator and blocking mechanism are worth a closer read. For pure pretraining interests, a quick skim is enough.

recommendation.zh: 首个千级工具集下的长程规划benchmark，看§3实验设置和Table 2阻塞场景结果即可，揭示当前模型动态纠错能力极弱。
recommendation.en: First long-horizon planning benchmark with 1000+ tools; read §3 setup and Table 2 blocking results, which show current models have extremely weak dynamic error recovery.

paper.title: Skill Coverage: A Test Adequacy Metric for Agent Skills
paper.abstract: Agent skills encode reusable procedural knowledge that guides large language model agents across tasks and execution contexts. Existing evaluations primarily assess skills through task level outcomes, yet task success alone does not reveal which parts of a skill have been exercised or which remain untested. We introduce skill coverage, a test adequacy metric that treats the skill artifact as the object under test. Our approach extracts observable skill behavior constraints from skill documents a

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent评测仅通过任务级成功率评估可复用技能的效果，但无法揭示技能文档中编码的哪些行为约束被实际执行、哪些未被测试，导致技能复用、适配和优化决策缺乏可审计的依据。
summary.importance: 提出了将可复用技能本身作为测试对象的artifact级评测视角，补充了任务级成功率之外的互补信号；从自然语言文本中抽取可审计行为约束的思路，可迁移到预训练合成数据校验、指令数据约束验证等场景。
summary.technical_approach: 首先从自然语言技能文档中抽取源锚定的技能行为约束（SBC），用EARS受控自然语言将异构的技能文本规范化为有限的可审计约束集合，过滤背景描述和偶发实现细节；其次基于Oracle覆盖思想，定义只有当Agent轨迹提供足够可观测证据证明相关场景被实例化、且约束行为可被判定时，才视为该约束被覆盖，采用二值（覆盖/未覆盖）判断规则，不额外打分。
summary.experiments: 在350条约束-轨迹对上验证LLM判定与人工标注的一致性，达成93.71%的一致率，Cohen's κ=0.874；在SkillsBench的78个源任务、7种Agent-模型配置、每种配置3条轨迹上测试，现有执行平均仅覆盖39.90%-43.98%的抽取到的技能行为约束，证明任务成功与技能的充分测试是相互独立的两类信号。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第3节问题形式化部分（理解SBC的定义和约束抽取规则，约10分钟），第4节覆盖判定协议，第5节的SkillsBench覆盖率统计结果；全文泛读总时长约25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent evaluations assess reusable skills only through task-level success rates, which cannot reveal which behavioral constraints encoded in skill documents are actually exercised during execution and which remain untested, leaving no auditable basis for skill reuse, adaptation and improvement decisions.
summary_en.importance: It introduces an artifact-level test adequacy perspective that treats reusable skills as the test object, providing a complementary signal beyond task-level outcomes. The framework of extracting auditable behavioral constraints from natural language documents can be transferred to scenarios like pre-training synthetic data validation and instruction constraint verification.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, extract source-grounded Skill Behavior Constraints (SBCs) from natural-language skill documents, normalizing heterogeneous skill prose into a finite set of auditable constraints via EARS-style controlled natural language while filtering out background text and incidental implementation details. Then adapt oracle-based coverage rules: a constraint is marked as covered only when the agent trajectory provides sufficient observable evidence to prove the relevant scenario is instantiated and the constrained behavior is judgeable, using a binary cover/not-cover judgment without additional scoring.
summary_en.experiments: Validated the LLM-based coverage attribution protocol against human labels on 350 constraint-trajectory pairs, achieving 93.71% agreement and Cohen's κ = 0.874. Applied the protocol to 78 SkillsBench tasks across 7 agent-model configurations with 3 traces per configuration; existing executions cover only 39.90–43.98% of extracted SBCs on average, confirming that task success and adequate skill testing are independent signals.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 3 (problem formulation and SBC definition, ~10 min), Section 4 (coverage judgment protocol), and Section 5 (SkillsBench coverage statistics). Full skimming takes around 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 技能覆盖度补全了任务成功率的盲区，读§3的约束提取方法和§4的覆盖度统计即可，可用于后训练技能对齐评测
recommendation.en: Skill coverage fills the blind spot of task success rate; read §3 for constraint extraction and §4 for coverage statistics, useful for post-training skill alignment evaluation

paper.title: Specialize Roles, Mix Deployments: Pushing the Cost-Accuracy Frontier of LLM Agent Teams
paper.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed as multi-role teams, where tasks are divided across specialized roles such as planner, executor, and verifier. In these systems, cost and accuracy are no longer properties of a single model: they depend on which model fills each role and where it is hosted, including API, self-hosted, and hybrid deployment. Existing agentic benchmarks typically evaluate fixed models or fixed agent configurations, and therefore offer limited guidance for cost-accuracy-optimal

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是多角色 LLM agent team 的评测与部署选择问题：在 planner、executor、verifier 等角色被不同模型承担时，准确率和成本不再属于单个模型，而属于角色分配、部署方式和任务域的组合。现有固定模型或固定 agent 配置的 benchmark 很难回答哪个模型该放在哪个角色、用 API 还是自托管。
summary.importance: 这篇是 agent 评测与部署 benchmark，和预训练关系较远，但对 post-train 后的模型能力分析有参考价值。它把 agent 系统的成本-准确率问题拆成角色级贡献，有助于判断模型能力瓶颈来自规划、执行还是验证。对基座研究的间接价值在于：同一个模型在不同 agent role 中的边际收益不同，这比单一任务分数更接近实际使用中的能力画像。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 AgentCARD，围绕 Cost、Accuracy、Role assignment、Deployment mode 做 role-aware evaluation。它不是新增一个静态任务集，而是把已有 agentic benchmarks 改造成角色分解评测。系统包含四部分：planner-executor 或 planner-verifier-executor 的评测 harness；统一 API、自托管、混合部署的 per-task cost model；基于 Pareto frontier 的成本-准确率分析；基于 Shapley value 的 role-criticality diagnostic，用来估计哪个角色是瓶颈，从而减少模型组合搜索。这个设计的关键区别在于，它评估的是 team configuration，而不是单模型能力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五类已有任务域：开放域工具使用、金融、医学推理、代码和数学。论文评估四个 API 模型之间的 16 种 planner-executor 分配，并加入自托管与混合部署配置。主要结果包括：异构 team 在合适角色分配下准确率最高可提升 44%；同一对模型反向分配可能降低 36%；Pareto frontier 经常由异构 team 占据；合适的异构配置可以用 1.4x 到 12x 更低的 per-task cost 匹配最强同构 team；planner 与 executor 的能力回报在不同领域最多相差 40%；三角色 plan-verify-execute pilot 在相近成本下比最强两角色 baseline 高 9.4%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15–25 分钟。重点看 benchmark 设计、cost model、Pareto frontier 分析和 Shapley role-criticality diagnostic。实验表格里应优先看角色互换导致的性能变化，以及不同 domain 中 planner/executor 哪个更关键。对预训练研究员，主要价值不是 agent 框架本身，而是它提供了一种更细粒度的能力诊断方式：模型的规划、执行、验证能力可能不能用一个总分概括。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses evaluation and deployment selection for multi-role LLM agent teams. Once roles such as planner, executor, and verifier are assigned to different models, accuracy and cost are no longer properties of a single model; they depend on the role assignment, deployment mode, and task domain. Standard fixed-model or fixed-agent benchmarks do not answer which model should fill which role under a given cost budget.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent evaluation and deployment benchmark, not a pretraining paper. Its value for foundation-model research is diagnostic: it separates model capability by role and shows that the same model can have different marginal value as a planner, executor, or verifier. That is a more deployment-relevant capability profile than a single aggregate benchmark score, and it can inform post-training evaluation and model selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces AgentCARD, a role-aware benchmark framework covering Cost, Accuracy, Role assignment, and Deployment mode. Rather than creating a new static task suite, it converts existing agentic benchmarks into role-decomposed evaluations. The framework includes a planner-executor and planner-verifier-executor harness, a unified per-task cost model for API, self-hosted, and hybrid serving, Pareto-frontier analysis for cost-accuracy tradeoffs, and a Shapley-based role-criticality diagnostic to identify the bottleneck role. The key design choice is to evaluate team configurations rather than individual models.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans five domains: open-domain tool use, finance, medical reasoning, coding, and mathematics. It tests all 16 planner-executor assignments among four API models, along with self-hosted and hybrid variants. The main findings are that heterogeneous teams can improve accuracy by up to 44% when models are assigned to suitable roles, while reversing the same pair can reduce accuracy by 36%. Heterogeneous teams often occupy the Pareto frontier and can match the strongest homogeneous team at 1.4x to 12x lower per-task cost. Planner and executor upgrade returns differ by up to 40% across domains. A three-role plan-verify-execute pilot adds up to 9.4% accuracy over the strongest two-agent baseline at comparable cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction, cost model, Pareto analysis, and the Shapley role-criticality diagnostic. In the results, prioritize the role-swap comparisons and the domain-specific planner-versus-executor bottleneck analysis. For foundation-model researchers, the useful point is not the agent framework itself, but the finer capability decomposition: planning, execution, and verification may need separate measurement rather than a single aggregate score.

recommendation.zh: 关注点在异构 agent team 的算力/成本分配而非建模范式，Shapley 瓶颈诊断和 Pareto 图值得 serving/agent 团队看图即可。
recommendation.en: The value is in heterogeneous agent-team cost allocation rather than modeling; read the Shapley bottleneck diagnostic and Pareto plots if you work on agent serving.

paper.title: ORAgentBench: Can LLM Agents Solve Challenging Operations Research Tasks End to End?
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for multi-step tasks in executable environments, yet their ability to perform realistic operations research (OR) work remains unclear. Existing OR evaluations often decouple modeling from solving, rely on pre-formalized or text-only instances, and rarely test the full workflow from operational artifacts to validated decisions. In this work, we introduce ORAgentBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for evaluating autonomous age

summary.core_problem: 现有 OR 评测通常只测建模或求解的局部环节，无法衡量 LLM agent 从业务材料到可验证决策的端到端能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent benchmark。它把运筹优化任务包装成可执行环境，要求 agent 读自然语言 brief、多文件数据和配置，再写代码求解并提交结构化结果，评测更接近真实工作流。
summary.technical_approach: ORAgentBench 包含 107 个经人工审核的任务，每个任务有隔离执行环境、自然语言描述、多文件输入、配置文件和提交 schema。评测使用隐藏 validator 检查 schema 合法性、硬约束可行性和归一化目标质量，避免只用文本答案或预形式化问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要称评测了 14 个 frontier agent，但给出的片段未包含具体模型名单、分数、失败模式和提升幅度。实验重点应是端到端 OR 工作流中建模、编码、执行、约束满足和目标优化质量的综合表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing OR evaluations often test only isolated modeling or solving steps, leaving unclear whether LLM agents can perform the full workflow from operational artifacts to validated decisions.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent benchmark contribution. It turns operations-research tasks into executable environments where agents must read natural-language briefs, multi-file data, and configs, then write code and submit structured solutions.
summary_en.technical_approach: ORAgentBench contains 107 human-reviewed tasks, each packaged with an isolated environment, natural-language brief, multi-file inputs, configuration artifacts, and a required submission schema. Hidden validators check schema validity, hard-constraint feasibility, and normalized objective quality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that fourteen frontier agents are evaluated, but the provided excerpt does not include model names, scores, failure modes, or quantitative gaps. The evaluation targets end-to-end modeling, coding, execution, constraint satisfaction, and objective optimization.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent eval 资产知道即可；预训练侧只需看 validator 设计，OR 任务分布本身不太会改变模型训练判断。
recommendation.en: Useful as an agent-eval asset; for pretraining, only the validator design matters, while the OR task mix is unlikely to change training priors.

paper.title: CEO-Bench: Can Agents Play the Long Game?
paper.abstract: Language model agents are becoming proficient executors at isolated, short-horizon tasks such as software engineering and customer service. Yet real-world challenges require a combination of sophisticated skills that remain largely untested in agents: (1) navigating long horizons amid uncertainty; (2) acquiring information in noisy environments; (3) adapting to a changing world; (4) orchestrating multiple moving parts toward a coherent goal. We introduce CEO-Bench, which evaluates these capabili

summary.core_problem: 解决现有Agent评测多集中于孤立短程任务，无法联合评估长 horizon决策、噪声环境信息获取、环境适应、多任务协调等真实世界核心能力的问题。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次提出模拟创业公司500天运营的长 horizon Agent评测基准CEO-Bench，覆盖4类核心能力的联合测试。
summary.technical_approach: 构建可编程Python仿真环境，模拟公司定价、营销、预算等多维度运营决策流程，要求Agent分析噪声业务数据、制定长期策略、通过编程协调跨时间步的多类决策。
summary.experiments: 当前最强Agent系统在该基准上表现不佳（原摘要截断未给出具体量化结果），暴露出现有Agent在长 horizon规划、噪声信号处理、多任务协调上的显著缺陷。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation that existing agent evaluations focus on isolated short-horizon tasks, failing to jointly assess core real-world capabilities: long-horizon decision-making, information acquisition in noisy environments, adaptation to dynamic worlds, and coordination of multiple interconnected components.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution; introduces CEO-Bench, the first long-horizon agent evaluation benchmark simulating 500 days of startup operation, for joint testing of 4 core agent capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a programmable Python simulation environment modeling multidimensional startup operations (pricing, marketing, budgeting, etc.), requiring agents to analyze noisy business data, formulate long-term strategies, and coordinate cross-timestep multi-type decisions via programming.
summary_en.experiments: State-of-the-art agent systems perform poorly on the benchmark (full quantitative results omitted in truncated abstract), revealing significant deficiencies of current agents in long-horizon planning, noisy signal processing, and multi-task coordination.

recommendation.zh: 长 horizon Agent评测基准，若需拓展预训练模型的决策能力评测维度可参考，仅阅读benchmark设计章节即可。
recommendation.en: Long-horizon agent evaluation benchmark; refer to it only if you need to expand the decision-making capability evaluation dimensions of pretrained models, just read the benchmark design section.

paper.title: Beyond the Current Observation: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Controllable Non-Markov Games
paper.abstract: Deploying multimodal foundation models as closed-loop policies increasingly requires conditioning actions on observations that are no longer visible. However, existing benchmarks either expose the full state, conflate hidden-state reconstruction with other agent skills, or test recall only after an episode has ended. We introduce RNG-Bench (Reconstructive Non-Markov Games), a benchmark suite designed to isolate a base model's ability to reconstruct past observations and act on them during multi-

summary.core_problem: 评估多模态大模型在非马尔可夫交互环境中，能否记住已经消失的视觉观察，并在后续动作中正确使用这些记忆。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测基准。它把“过去观察重构”从规划、工具使用、语言推理等能力中拆出来，适合检查 VLM/MLLM 作为闭环策略时的短期视觉记忆与空间整合能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RNG-Bench，包括 Matching Pairs 和 3D Maze 两类可控游戏。前者要求模型记住短暂翻开的卡牌身份与位置，后者要求模型把第一视角观察整合成空间地图。基准使用统一交互 harness，并控制网格大小、视觉图案、观察模态三个难度轴；还引入 head-to-head duel protocol 来降低实例差异带来的噪声，并设计 Memory Gap 相关度量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体评测模型列表、参数规模、样本量或提升数字。可确认的是实验围绕两类非马尔可夫游戏展开，目标是比较多模态基础模型在不同难度、模态和隐藏状态需求下的闭环表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自复旦大学、上海创新研究院、上海人工智能实验室、浙江大学和香港中文大学。Dahua Lin、Jiaqi Wang 所在团队长期参与 OpenMMLab、多模态模型与评测体系建设；Haodong Duan 参与过多模态评测相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether multimodal large language models can reconstruct no-longer-visible observations and use that memory for actions in non-Markov interactive environments.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. It isolates past-observation reconstruction from broader skills such as planning, language reasoning, and tool use, making it useful for probing visual memory and spatial integration in MLLMs used as closed-loop policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce RNG-Bench, built around two controllable games: Matching Pairs, where card identities are briefly revealed and must later be recalled by location, and 3D Maze, where egocentric observations must be integrated into a spatial map. The suite uses a unified interaction harness with three difficulty axes—grid size, visual pattern, and observation modality—and adds a head-to-head duel protocol to control instance-level variance, together with a Memory Gap-style metric.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the exact evaluated model list, model sizes, dataset size, or numerical results. The confirmed setup evaluates multimodal foundation models across two non-Markov games under controlled difficulty and modality conditions.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Fudan University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Zhejiang University, and The Chinese University of Hong Kong. Dahua Lin and Jiaqi Wang are associated with teams known for OpenMMLab and multimodal model/evaluation work; Haodong Duan has contributed to multimodal evaluation work.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM agent 记忆评测备查即可；看任务设计和 duel protocol，别把分数当预训练能力结论。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for VLM-agent memory evaluation; read the task design and duel protocol, but do not overread scores as pretraining capability evidence.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: OmniGameArena: A Unified UE5 Benchmark for VLM Game Agents with Improvement Dynamics
paper.abstract: Vision-language model (VLM) agents are increasingly deployed in interactive game environments. Yet game benchmarks for VLM agents typically report a single first-attempt score per (agent, game) pair, focus on single-agent Solo play, and lack unified protocols for evaluating heterogeneous agent classes (commercial VLMs, open-weight VLMs, and specialized game policies) on the same footing. We address these gaps with OmniGameArena, a real-time benchmark of twelve newly built Unreal Engine 5 games s

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM游戏Agent基准仅报告单次冷启动分数，仅覆盖单智能体场景，缺乏统一协议评估不同类型Agent的能力。
summary.importance: 首个覆盖单智能体、PvP、合作模式的统一UE5游戏Agent基准，首次提出反思迭代的改进动态作为新的评估维度。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含12个全新UE5游戏的OmniGameArena基准，统一动作接口；提出改进动态曲线IDC，通过工具使用的反思LLM自主迭代优化技能提示，评估Agent的改进能力与泛化性。
summary.experiments: 在12个游戏场景下完成12类不同Agent的评测，同时报告冷启动分数、改进曲线、泛化性能三类指标。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM game agent benchmarks only report single cold-start scores, only cover single-agent scenarios, and lack unified protocols to evaluate capabilities of different types of agents.
summary_en.importance: First unified UE5 game agent benchmark covering solo, PvP and cooperative modes, first proposing improvement dynamics across reflection iterations as a new evaluation dimension.
summary_en.technical_approach: Build OmniGameArena benchmark containing 12 new UE5 games with unified action interfaces; propose Improvement Dynamics Curve (IDC), which uses a tool-using reflector LLM to autonomously iteratively optimize skill prompts, evaluating agent's improvement capability and generalization.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluate 12 different agents across 12 game scenarios, reporting three types of metrics: cold-start score, improvement curve, and generalization performance.

recommendation.zh: Agent评测新增的改进动态维度值得关注，直接看§3的评测协议设计即可，具体实验结果可忽略。
recommendation.en: The novel Improvement Dynamics dimension for agent evaluation is noteworthy; refer only to §3 for protocol design, skip specific experimental results.

paper.title: Hardening Agent Benchmarks with Adversarial Hacker-Fixer Loops
paper.abstract: Agent benchmarks score submissions with outcome verifiers that are typically hand-written and brittle, leaving them open to reward hacking. We audit 1,968 tasks across five terminal-agent benchmarks and find 323 (16%) hackable by frontier models given only the task description. This corrupts both leaderboard rankings and RL training signal, yet the standard response is manual and reactive.   We introduce the hacker-fixer loop, a method for building exploit-resistant verifiers without per-task ma

summary.core_problem: 现有智能体基准的手工编写结果验证器普遍存在脆弱性，易被前沿模型破解，导致排行榜排名与RL训练信号失真
summary.importance: 评测方法创新，提出无需逐任务人工修复的抗破解验证器构建范式，解决智能体基准的奖励破解问题
summary.technical_approach: 引入黑客-修复器循环：交替运行三类LLM智能体，黑客尝试不解决任务就通过验证器，修复器修补验证器以拒绝发现的漏洞，求解器确认修补后的验证器仍接受合法解决方案；同时增加验证器访问权限、支持补丁跨任务迁移以扩大漏洞发现范围
summary.experiments: 审计5个终端智能体基准的1968个任务，发现16%可被前沿模型破解；在KernelBench上应用该循环，可消除绝大多数可被利用的验证器漏洞，同时不影响合法解的通过率

summary_en.core_problem: Hand-written outcome verifiers in existing agent benchmarks are generally brittle and easily hacked by frontier models, corrupting leaderboard rankings and RL training signals
summary_en.importance: Evaluation method innovation, proposing a paradigm for building exploit-resistant verifiers without per-task manual patching to address reward hacking in agent benchmarks
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce the hacker-fixer loop: alternately run three LLM agents, where a hacker attempts to pass the verifier without solving the task, a fixer patches the verifier to reject each discovered exploit, and a solver confirms the patched verifier still admits legitimate solutions; additionally add verifier access and enable cross-task patch transfer to broaden the range of discovered exploits
summary_en.experiments: Audited 1,968 tasks across 5 terminal-agent benchmarks and found 16% are hackable by frontier models; applying the loop on KernelBench eliminates the vast majority of exploitable verifier vulnerabilities without affecting the pass rate of legitimate solutions
summary_en.authors_note: Aditi Raghunathan from UC Berkeley, known for research on LLM alignment and robustness

recommendation.zh: 智能体评测基准抗破解的自动化方案，可直接用于提升SWE类基准的信号质量，重点看任务审计部分的漏洞统计与循环迭代机制
recommendation.en: An automated scheme for hardening agent benchmarks against exploits, which can be directly used to improve signal quality of SWE-style benchmarks, focus on vulnerability statistics in the task audit section and the loop iteration mechanism

paper.title: SubtleMemory: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Relational Memory Discrimination in Long-Horizon AI Agents
paper.abstract: Persistent AI assistants, such as OpenClaw, accumulate large collections of related memories over long-term interactions. As these memories grow, they may reinforce one another, diverge across contexts, or directly conflict, making correct assistance depend on memory relations rather than isolated recall. Existing long-term memory benchmarks rarely probe how agents preserve and utilize such relations during downstream tasks. To address this gap, we introduce SubtleMemory, a benchmark for fine-gr

summary.core_problem: 现有长程记忆评测基准主要测试独立记忆条目的检索或操作能力，而较少考察 Agent 在执行下游任务时，如何区分和利用多条相似记忆之间的细微关系（互补、歧异、矛盾）。持久 AI 助手在长期交互中积累大量高度相关的记忆，这些记忆可能互相强化、在不同语境下微妙偏离、或直接冲突，正确响应依赖对记忆关系的判断而非孤立召回。
summary.importance: 揭示了当前长程记忆评测的盲区——独立召回正确不代表能正确处理记忆之间的关系。尤其是发现即使在 oracle 证据条件下，前沿模型（如 gpt-5.4）在处理矛盾记忆样本时仍然表现远差于互补或歧异样本，说明现有 LLM 难以识别未解决的冲突并在证据不一致时保持克制。这对未来记忆系统和模型能力设计有直接指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 构造关系受控的潜层语义变体（complementary / nuanced / contradictory），将其嵌入自然的多轮用户-Agent 交互历史中，然后基于解析目标（resolution target）构建评测查询，要求 Agent 从分散在长程对话中的相关记忆中正确推理。评测框架支持三种被测对象：独立记忆系统、框架原生记忆模块的 Agent、插件式记忆 Agent；并提供任务级诊断框架，分解记忆构建、检索、响应生成三个阶段的失败。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖 6 个独立记忆系统、2 个带原生记忆模块的 Claw 式 Agent、3 个带插件记忆模块的 Claw 式 Agent。主要发现：(1) 当前系统在记忆形成阶段难以保留细粒度关系信息，在推理阶段难以检索足够的任务相关证据；(2) 即使在 oracle 证据 + gpt-5.4 + 高度优化的 prompting 条件下，矛盾记忆样本仍远难于互补或歧异样本。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看 Section 3 的评测构造方法论（语义种子、变体生成、三种关系类型的设计细节）和 Section 4 的评测结果（尤其是矛盾记忆 vs 互补记忆的差距分析）。Section 5 的相关工作综述也值得浏览，提供了长程记忆评测现状的全貌。预计阅读时间 30-45 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构未明确标注（论文未提供）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-term memory benchmarks primarily test retrieval or manipulation of isolated memory items, but rarely probe how agents preserve and utilize subtle relations among multiple related memories (complementary, nuanced, contradictory) during downstream tasks. Persistent AI assistants accumulate large collections of highly related memories over time, and correct behavior depends on judging memory relations rather than isolated recall.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a blind spot in current long-horizon memory evaluation: correct isolated recall does not guarantee correct handling of inter-memory relations. A particularly notable finding is that even under oracle evidence conditions, frontier models such as gpt-5.4 still perform dramatically worse on contradictory-memory instances than on complementary or nuanced instances, suggesting current LLMs struggle to recognize unresolved conflict and abstain from unsupported resolution when evidence is inconsistent.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs relation-controlled latent semantic variants (complementary, nuanced, contradictory) embedded into natural multi-turn user-agent interaction histories, then builds evaluation queries grounded in resolution targets that require reasoning over semantically related memories scattered across the conversation. The evaluation framework supports three test subjects: standalone memory systems, framework-native memory agents, and plugin-based memory agents, with a task-level diagnostic framework decomposing failures across memory construction, retrieval, and response generation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 6 standalone memory systems, 2 Claw-style agents with native memory modules, and 3 Claw-style agents with plugin memory modules. Key findings: (1) Current systems struggle both to preserve fine-grained relational information during memory formation and to retrieve sufficient task-relevant evidence during inference; (2) Contradictory-memory instances remain dramatically harder than complementary or nuanced instances even with oracle evidence, gpt-5.4, and highly optimized prompting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (benchmark construction methodology: semantic seeds, variant generation, three relation type designs) and Section 4 (evaluation results, especially the gap between contradictory vs complementary memory handling). Section 5's related work also provides a good overview of the long-term memory evaluation landscape. Estimated reading time: 30-45 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated in the provided content

paper.title: 3DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agentic Procedural 3D Modeling Via Code

summary.core_problem: 缺少一个能系统评测“VLM/LLM 作为 agent 在真实 3D 软件里用代码做程序化建模”的基准：既要有成规模的 prompt↔代码↔3D 资产对齐数据，又要覆盖真实几何复杂度，还要支持多轮迭代（执行报错、重试、视觉自检、补充文档）并提供可靠的自动指标与人工偏好评测。
summary.importance:
这是典型的 eval 资产论文，对基座预训练的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在给“代码能力 + 视觉条件 + 工具调用/执行反馈”提供一个更接近真实工作流的评测场。对预训练研究的启发点主要有两类：
1) 数据形态：程序化 3D 代码往往长、结构化、强约束（可执行性/物理合理性），可作为未来多模态/工具使用预训练或 mid-train 的潜在数据源；
2) 评测范式：把 deterministic execution feedback 纳入多轮 harness，能更稳定地区分模型的“会写代码”与“能把东西做对”。
但如果当前关注点是纯文本预训练 recipe/scaling/tokenizer，这篇更多是“评测与数据资产参考”，不是训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach:
3DCodeBench 的核心是基准构建与评测协议：
- 数据：从 Infinigen 的 procedural factories 抽取并用 agentic curation + 人工校验，得到 26K 的 text/image prompts ↔ standalone code ↔ 3D object 三元组，覆盖 212 类。强调真实复杂度：如 bird/crab/dragonfly 等类别平均 400+ 行代码。
- 评测设置：不仅 single-shot，还评测多轮 agent 行为，包括执行错误反馈、重试、视觉自我批评、API 文档增强等，模拟真实 Blender 工作流。
- 指标：
  1) 可执行性（代码能否跑通）；
  2) 视角/外观相似度（SigLIP-2、DINOv3 等视觉表征度量）；
  3) 3D 几何对齐（Chamfer distance、Uni3D 等）。
- 人评：上线 3DCodeArena，用 pairwise preference 做 Elo 排名，补足自动指标对“审美/感知质量”的缺口。
方法取舍很明确：不试图发明新的生成模型，而是把“数据—环境—指标—人评”闭环搭起来，让 agentic 3D 建模能力可复现地被测量。
summary.experiments:
论文报告对 12 个先进 VLM（包含 Gemini/Claude/GPT 系列）做系统评测。全文给出的主要经验结论是：
- 主要瓶颈在 physical plausibility，而不仅是 executability：模型常生成断裂部件、结构对不齐，说明几何/物理常识不足。
- test-time scaling：多轮迭代在 Blender 的确定性执行反馈下能显著改善结果，提示 harness 设计对释放模型能力很关键。
题面未提供更细的数值（如各模型 Elo、可执行率、Chamfer 等具体表格），需要在论文实验章节与 leaderboard/arena 页面查具体数字与统计显著性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–50 分钟）：
1) 先看数据构建：Infinigen factories 如何抽取成“standalone code”，agentic curation 的失败模式与人工校验标准（决定数据是否可用于训练）。
2) 看评测协议：多轮设置的状态机/工具接口、错误反馈如何注入、重试上限与停止条件（这部分对做 agent eval 很有复用价值）。
3) 看指标与人评一致性分析：自动指标与 Elo 的相关性、哪些类别最不一致（能反推指标盲区）。
4) 如果只想用它做选型参考，直接看主结果表与 3DCodeArena 排名，预计 10–15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: There is no standardized benchmark that evaluates VLM/LLM agents doing procedural 3D modeling via code inside real 3D software: you need aligned prompt–code–asset data at scale, realistic geometric complexity, multi-turn iterative workflows with execution feedback, and both automated and human-preference evaluation.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation/dataset contribution rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its value to foundation-model researchers is (i) providing a realistic testbed for code+vision+tool-use capabilities, and (ii) highlighting that deterministic execution feedback and iterative harness design can separate “code that runs” from “assets that are physically plausible.” It may also become a candidate data source for future multimodal/mid-training, but it does not directly advance scaling laws, tokenization, or core text pretraining recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
3DCodeBench is built around benchmark construction and protocol design:
- Data: extracted procedural factories from Infinigen and converted (via an agentic curation pipeline plus human verification) into 26K triplets of text/image prompts ↔ standalone procedural code ↔ rendered/constructed 3D objects, spanning 212 categories. The benchmark emphasizes real complexity (some classes average 400+ lines of code).
- Agentic evaluation: beyond single-shot prompting, models are evaluated in controlled multi-turn settings with execution-error feedback, retries, visual self-critique, and API documentation augmentation—closer to real Blender workflows.
- Metrics: executability, perceptual view similarity (e.g., SigLIP-2, DINOv3 embeddings), and 3D geometric alignment (e.g., Chamfer distance, Uni3D).
- Human eval: 3DCodeArena collects pairwise preferences and produces Elo rankings to capture perceptual/aesthetic quality that automated metrics miss.
The design choice is to standardize the full loop (data–environment–metrics–human preference) rather than proposing a new generator.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates 12 advanced VLMs (including Gemini/Claude/GPT families). The main reported findings are:
- Physical plausibility is the dominant bottleneck beyond mere executability: models often produce disconnected parts and incorrect structural alignment.
- Test-time scaling helps: multi-turn refinement with deterministic Blender execution feedback improves outcomes, indicating the harness matters.
Specific quantitative tables (Elo scores, executability rates, Chamfer, etc.) are not included in the provided excerpt and should be taken from the main results section and the public arena/leaderboard.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–50 minutes):
1) Read the dataset construction details: how Infinigen factories are turned into standalone code, and what the human verification criteria are.
2) Study the multi-turn evaluation harness: how errors are surfaced, retry policies, termination conditions, and how documentation is injected.
3) Check the analysis on metric–human agreement to understand where automated metrics fail.
4) If you only need model rankings, jump to the main results tables and the 3DCodeArena Elo leaderboard (10–15 minutes).

paper.title: LiteCoder-Terminal: Scaling Long-Horizon Terminal Environments for Learning Language Agents
paper.abstract: Mastering terminal environments requires language agents capable of multi-step planning, feedback-grounded execution, and dynamic state adaptation. However, training such agents is currently bottlenecked by a reliance on scraped external repositories, which limits domain diversity, environment controllability, and the targeting of specific capability deficits. We introduce LiteCoder-Terminal-Gen, a zero-dependency synthesis pipeline that autonomously generates executable and verifiable terminal

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 terminal agent 训练数据稀缺且来源受限的问题。现有做法大量依赖 GitHub issue、Stack Overflow 或现成仓库任务，这会带来三个限制：领域覆盖受外部语料分布约束，环境状态不可控，且很难针对模型的具体短板定向生成训练样本。作者提出一个 zero-dependency 的合成管线，试图不依赖外部仓库，直接从高层领域规范出发，自动生成可执行、可验证、可用于 SFT 和 RL 的 terminal 环境与专家轨迹。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，这篇文章不是核心方向；它更接近 agent post-training/data synthesis。但它有两个值得注意的点。第一，它把“环境合成”而不是“答案合成”作为数据构造中心，这比单纯蒸馏轨迹更接近真实 agent 学习所需的交互分布。第二，它强调可控生成训练环境，用来补模型能力短板，这和持续后训练、targeted data mixture、能力定向 curriculum 有相通之处。若关心代码 agent、tool-use 或 environment-grounded RL，这篇文章提供了一个较完整的数据生产思路；若只看 LLM 预训练主线，它的启发主要在数据生成机制，而不在模型或优化方法本身。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 LiteCoder-Terminal-Gen。它不是从外部问题库抓任务再清洗，而是从 domain specification 出发，自动生成任务描述、实例化环境、构造测试用例，并最终产出专家轨迹或可验证 RL 环境。文中覆盖 10 个 terminal domain，包括 AI&ML、build tools、data science、networking、security、system administration、version control、coding、scientific computing 和 games。

任务生成阶段采用类似 Magpie 的 aligned LLM 自回归补全方式：给定领域相关 system prompt，再拼接一个用户轮次起始标记，不提供真实用户输入，让模型“补出”一个符合该领域的高质量任务请求。之后做 feasibility check，筛掉复杂度不合适、描述不清或资源不可得的任务。这个设计的优点是摆脱外部语料依赖，同时保留 aligned model 在任务表述上的自然性。

但自然语言任务描述还不能直接变成可交互环境，因此作者又设计了一个五阶段顺序合成流程，把任务逐步落地成真正可执行的 terminal world。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整展开五阶段细节，但从引言和方法描述可知，流程至少包括：生成具体文件布局和背景工件、实例化底层环境、定义预期输出与成功条件、并构造细粒度 test cases 作为 scoring oracle。换句话说，它合成的不是单条问答，而是一个带状态、带资源、带验证器的任务实例。

在此基础上，作者构建两类资源。LiteCoder-Terminal-SFT 包含 11,255 条专家轨迹，教师模型包括 MiniMax 系列，用于微调 Qwen 家族 4B、14B、32B 基座模型。LiteCoder-Terminal-RL 则包含 602 个可执行、可验证环境，用于 verifier-grounded rollout 和 trajectory-level preference optimization。RL 部分采用 DMPO，在 4B SFT 模型上继续训练。

从方法性质看，这篇文章的主要创新不在 RL 算法，而在“从零生成环境 + 轨迹 + 验证器”的数据工厂。它试图把 agent 训练从被动收集互联网任务，转成按能力缺口主动合成任务。
summary.experiments:
实验主要验证三件事：合成数据能否训练出更强的 terminal agent、这种提升是否跨模型规模稳定、以及合成的可执行环境能否继续支持 RL 偏好优化。

SFT 方面，作者用 LiteCoder-Terminal-SFT 微调了 Qwen 家族 4B 到 32B 模型。最好的 32B 模型在 Terminal Bench 1.0、Terminal Bench 2.0、Terminal Bench Pro 上分别达到 29.06%、18.54%、34.00% 的 pass@1。文中同时强调，小模型也相对各自 base model 有稳定提升，说明合成数据不是只对大模型有效。

RL 方面，作者基于 602 个 LiteCoder-Terminal-RL 环境做 verifier-grounded rollouts，并在 4B SFT 模型上应用 DMPO。结果是在更难的 Terminal Bench 2.0 和 Terminal Bench Pro 上继续取得增益，说明“可执行环境 + 自动验证器”确实能提供超出 SFT 的训练信号。不过从给出的内容看，RL 增益幅度和稳定性细节没有 SFT 部分那样充分展开，阅读时需要重点看主表和附录，确认提升是否显著、是否在多个种子和 domain 上一致。

如果从研究判断上看，实验最有说服力的是：作者没有只展示合成任务上的自测结果，而是拿外部 benchmark 做评估，并覆盖多个模型尺度。相对薄弱之处是，目前看到的数字更多是任务成功率层面，关于数据质量、环境多样性、教师轨迹噪声、以及合成任务与真实 terminal 分布差距的分析还需要读正文和附录确认。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓数据生成链路，再看 benchmark 结果。优先读 Introduction 和 LiteCoder-Terminal-Gen 方法总览，弄清楚它与“抓 GitHub issue 再做环境回放”的路线到底差在哪。然后看任务生成示意图和环境实例化流程图，确认它生成的是哪一层资产：任务文本、文件系统状态、测试脚本、还是完整交互轨迹。接着看 SFT 主结果表，判断不同参数规模下的收益是否一致；最后看 RL 部分，重点关注 DMPO 的训练设置、verifier 如何定义、以及 RL 相对 SFT 的额外收益。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。如果只想判断是否值得跟进，读引言、方法总览、主结果表和一个具体环境案例就够了。若想复用到自己的 agent 数据生产中，需要细看 feasibility check、环境合成模板、测试用例构造和教师轨迹生成细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a data bottleneck for terminal agents: most existing training pipelines depend on scraped external repositories such as GitHub issues or Stack Overflow, which limits domain diversity, environment controllability, and the ability to generate tasks targeted at specific capability gaps. The proposed solution is a zero-dependency synthesis pipeline that starts from high-level domain specifications and directly generates executable, verifiable terminal environments together with expert trajectories for both SFT and RL.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper. It sits closer to agent post-training and environment-grounded data synthesis. Still, it matters for two reasons. First, it treats environment synthesis, not just answer synthesis, as the central data-construction problem. That is more aligned with how agents actually learn from interaction. Second, it argues for controllable task generation aimed at specific weaknesses, which connects naturally to targeted continual training, capability-directed curricula, and data-mixture design. For researchers focused on coding agents, tool use, or environment-grounded RL, the paper offers a fairly complete data-production recipe. For pure LLM pretraining, the main value is in the data-generation mechanism rather than in model architecture or optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is LiteCoder-Terminal-Gen. Instead of scraping and filtering external task repositories, it starts from domain specifications and automatically generates task descriptions, instantiates environments, builds test cases, and finally produces either expert trajectories or executable RL environments. The paper covers 10 terminal domains, including AI&ML, build tools, data science, networking, security, system administration, version control, coding, scientific computing, and games.

Task generation uses a Magpie-like strategy with aligned LLMs. Given a domain-specific system prompt, the pipeline appends a user-turn start token without providing an actual user query, prompting the model to autoregressively complete a plausible task request in that domain. A feasibility filter then removes tasks that are too vague, too hard, or unsupported by available resources. The advantage is that task generation is no longer constrained by external corpora while still benefiting from the natural task phrasing learned by aligned models.

Natural-language task descriptions are not enough for interactive training, so the pipeline includes a multi-stage synthesis process that turns them into executable terminal worlds. The full five-stage details are not fully visible in the provided text, but the method clearly includes generating concrete file layouts and artifacts, instantiating the underlying environment, defining expected outputs and success conditions, and constructing robust test cases as scoring oracles. In other words, the system synthesizes not just prompts, but stateful task instances with resources and verifiers.

On top of this pipeline, the authors build two resources. LiteCoder-Terminal-SFT contains 11,255 expert trajectories generated by strong teacher models including MiniMax models, and is used to fine-tune Qwen-family base models from 4B to 32B. LiteCoder-Terminal-RL contains 602 executable and verifiable environments for verifier-grounded rollouts and trajectory-level preference optimization. The RL stage uses DMPO on top of the 4B SFT model.

Methodologically, the main novelty is not the RL algorithm. It is the data factory: generating environments, trajectories, and verifiers from scratch so that agent training can move from passive internet harvesting to active capability-targeted synthesis.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments aim to validate three claims: synthesized data can train stronger terminal agents, the gains are stable across model scales, and synthesized executable environments can support additional RL-style improvement.

For SFT, the authors fine-tune Qwen-family models from 4B to 32B on LiteCoder-Terminal-SFT. The best 32B model reaches 29.06%, 18.54%, and 34.00% pass@1 on Terminal Bench 1.0, Terminal Bench 2.0, and Terminal Bench Pro, respectively. The paper also states that smaller models consistently improve over their corresponding base models, suggesting the synthesized data is not only useful in the large-model regime.

For RL, the authors use 602 LiteCoder-Terminal-RL environments for verifier-grounded rollouts and apply DMPO to the 4B SFT model. This yields further gains on the harder Terminal Bench 2.0 and Terminal Bench Pro benchmarks, indicating that executable environments with automatic verifiers provide useful training signal beyond supervised trajectories. From the visible text, however, the RL section appears less detailed than the SFT section, so the main tables and appendix are worth checking for effect size, variance, and consistency across domains.

The strongest part of the empirical story is that evaluation is done on external terminal benchmarks rather than only on self-generated tasks, and that multiple model scales are covered. The weaker part, at least from the provided content, is that there is less visible analysis of data quality, environment diversity, teacher-trajectory noise, and the distribution gap between synthesized tasks and real terminal workloads.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, first understand the data-generation pipeline, then inspect the benchmark results. Start with the introduction and the LiteCoder-Terminal-Gen overview to see how this differs from the common scrape-and-replay approach built on GitHub issues or repositories. Then look at the task-generation and environment-instantiation diagrams to verify what is actually synthesized: task text, filesystem state, test scripts, or full interaction trajectories. After that, read the main SFT results table to check whether gains are consistent across scales. Finally, read the RL section with attention to the DMPO setup, how the verifier is defined, and how much RL adds beyond SFT.

Expected reading time is about 20-30 minutes. If the goal is only to decide whether to track it, the introduction, method overview, main results table, and one concrete environment example are enough. If the goal is to reuse the pipeline, pay close attention to the feasibility filter, environment-construction templates, test-case generation, and teacher-trajectory synthesis details.

recommendation.zh: 终端agent训练环境的合成框架和数据集，对agent研究有参考价值，但对预训练本身无直接启发。值得扫一眼方法和数据统计。
recommendation.en: Useful synthetic pipeline and dataset for terminal agent training, relevant for agent research but not directly for pre-training. Scan methods and data statistics.

paper.title: VibeSearchBench: Benchmarking Long-horizon Proactive Search in the Wild
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents score well on search benchmarks, yet real users consistently find results unsatisfying, revealing a persistent evaluation-experience gap. We attribute this gap to existing benchmarks' reliance on over-specified queries, single-turn interactions, and fixed-schema evaluation, none of which reflect real search behavior where users and agents collaboratively refine vague intent through multi-turn dialogue. We term this paradigm VibeSearch and introduce VibeSearchBench, a benchmark c

summary.core_problem: 这项工作提出并评测一种更接近真实用户搜索的长程交互任务：用户一开始只给出模糊需求，代理需要在多轮搜索、返回部分结果、追问偏好和调整方向中逐步逼近目标信息。它要解决的是现有搜索 benchmark 过度指定、单轮化、固定 schema 输出的问题。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的关系是间接的，但有用。它暴露了当前模型在长程意图挖掘、上下文压缩、跨轮记忆和结构化信息整合上的短板。结果还提示，单靠 agent harness 的子代理、局部记忆或长期记忆模块，不能明显弥补模型层面的不足。对预训练研究员来说，这类 benchmark 可以作为检验 long-horizon tool use、信息综合和 schema-free 结构化输出能力的评测资产，而不是训练 recipe 本身。
summary.technical_approach: VibeSearchBench 将任务定义为用户画像加目标知识图谱。用户画像包含背景、初始模糊查询，以及一组分阶段信息需求；每个阶段由触发条件控制，只有当代理的回答满足当前条件时，用户模拟器才披露下一阶段需求。搜索结束后，代理需要把收集到的信息整理成三元组列表，形成预测知识图谱。评测不依赖预设表格 schema，而是用预测图和人工标注真值图之间的 triplet-level graph matching 计算 precision、recall 和 F1。数据由 20 个领域的专业标注者构造，共 200 个任务，分为 VibeSearch-Pro 和 VibeSearch-Daily，覆盖中文和英文场景。
summary.experiments: 实验在生产型 agent harness OpenClaw 上评测 7 个前沿模型，并提供 ReAct 作为研究侧参考。整体分数偏低，表现最好的 Claude Opus 4.6 平均 F1 为 30.30。较高主动性，即每个用户回合约 7–8 次工具调用，通常带来更好结果；但资源消耗过高会因上下文溢出和信息压缩损失而降低效果。错误分析显示三类瓶颈：轨迹压缩带来 8–12 F1 的下降；没有模型能顺利触达用户模拟器的完成信号，说明意图引导效率不足；生成的知识图谱结构偏平，覆盖不到目标知识关系。对 OpenClaw 的子代理协作、局部记忆、长期记忆做消融后，未观察到显著收益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看任务形式化、用户模拟器的 progressive disclosure 机制、schema-free graph matching 评测，以及错误分析。若关注 agent 预训练或工具使用数据合成，可以看 OpenClaw 消融和轨迹压缩失败案例；它们比排行榜数字更能说明模型需要学习什么。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark targets long-horizon proactive search, where the user starts with an underspecified request and the agent must iteratively search, present partial findings, ask follow-up questions, and refine the information need. It addresses a gap in existing search benchmarks, which often use fully specified single-turn prompts and fixed output schemas.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining is indirect but concrete. The benchmark surfaces weaknesses in intent elicitation, long-horizon tool use, context compression, memory use, and structured synthesis. It also shows that adding harness-level mechanisms such as sub-agents or memory modules does not automatically solve these failures. For base-model research, the value is as an evaluation asset for model-level capabilities rather than as a new training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: VibeSearchBench represents each task with a user persona and a ground-truth knowledge graph. The persona includes the user background, an initial vague query, and staged hidden requirements. A progressive-disclosure user simulator reveals the next requirement only when the agent’s response satisfies the current trigger condition.
