Models evaluated include Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Qwen3.5-397B, and MiniMax M2.7. The best model reaches ~55% pass rate (score ≥ 75/100).
Additional findings: ~22% of tasks show up to ~90-point score swings across models (clear capability boundaries); generative tasks are handled better than formal reasoning (olympiad-level problems remain unsolved); token usage varies by >5× across models but is almost uncorrelated with quality (r ≈ -0.03).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in three passes:
- Task collection and curation: to judge realism, difficulty calibration, and reproducibility.
- Evaluation design: how the six verification signals are combined, and how judge bias is controlled.
- Results analysis: capability boundaries, behavioral phenotypes, and the token–quality disconnect.
~40–60 minutes is enough to extract the benchmark design and key phenomena; using it for training loops requires deeper inspection of task decomposability and how to turn rubrics into reward signals.

recommendation.zh: 把“真实长链路学术工作流”做成可执行基准这点有用；但先只看任务构成与评分rubric，没看到强基线前别过度解读排名。
recommendation.en: Useful as an executable long-horizon academic-workflow benchmark; skim the task taxonomy and scoring rubrics first, and don’t over-trust any leaderboard until strong baselines are shown.

paper.title: Talk is Cheap, Communication is Hard: Dynamic Grounding Failures and Repair in Multi-Agent Negotiation
paper.abstract: Grounding is the collaborative process of establishing mutual belief sufficient for the current communicative purpose. While static grounding maps language to a shared, externally observable context, dynamic grounding is a joint activity where meaning is negotiated through interaction. Current multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) benchmarks focus on static, one-shot tasks, overlooking the ability to repair grounding breakdowns across turns. We introduce an iterated, multi-turn negotiation game

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 多智能体协作中的 dynamic grounding failure：单个模型能独立算出较好策略，但两个模型通过多轮对话协商时，往往不能形成、维护和修复共同计划。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接影响有限，更接近 multi-agent evaluation 和 post-training 信号设计。它的启发在于：很多协作失败不是单步推理能力不足，而是互动过程中的承诺跟踪、指代绑定、误解修复和策略让步失败。如果要训练通用 agent，仅用最终得分或静态问答数据不够，可能需要包含多轮协商轨迹、显式修复行为和过程级奖励的训练数据。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造了一个可配置的资源分配谈判游戏。两个 agent 各自持有私有项目，每个项目有不同资源需求和收益；双方共享一个资源池，若联合购买超过容量，就发生 overdraw，双方得不到奖励。每轮决策前，agent 最多交换 5 条消息，消息本身不强制约束后续行动，属于 cheap talk；随后双方同时提交购买决策。游戏迭代 4 轮，可以固定或更换 partner，也可以固定或更换项目场景。这个设计让作者能区分个体规划能力和互动协作能力：如果 oracle 或单体规划可以找到优解，而 dyad 对话后仍失败，问题就更可能出在 grounding 和 commitment formation 上。论文还把失败归纳为四类：缺少共享历史时协调退化；已有上下文可能导致 stubborn anchoring；模型倾向 perfunctory fairness，即机械平分资源而不是最大化联合收益；以及 referential binding failure，即多轮中丢失先前承诺和指代关系。
summary.experiments: 给定内容中没有完整数值表，但主要实验结论清楚：单个 agent 在 oracle 条件下能够识别最优或接近最优策略，互动 dyad 则持续低于可达到的联合最优。差距主要不是信息不对称或单体推理失败，而是多轮对话中的计划形成和承诺维护失败。不同条件下的对比显示，共享历史有帮助，但也会引入锚定效应；更多上下文不一定带来更好的协调。交互轨迹分析支持四种失败模式，尤其是公平但低效的默认分配、对早期提案的过度固化，以及跨 turn 的承诺绑定错误。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–20 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 dynamic grounding 的定义，以及 Section 4.1 的游戏环境和实验条件；结果部分优先看 oracle baseline 与 interacting dyads 的差距，以及四类 failure mode 的 trace 分析。Related work 可快速扫过。若关注 agent post-training，可以重点看作者如何把可验证最优解、对话轨迹和失败诊断结合起来，这比单纯看最终 reward 更有训练信号设计价值。
summary.authors_note: Yiheng Yao（Stanford，通讯作者）；其余作者信息在给定内容中无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies dynamic grounding failures in LLM-based multi-agent negotiation. Individual agents can often identify good plans in isolation, but pairs of agents fail to form, maintain, and repair shared plans through multi-turn dialogue.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to base-model pretraining is limited. The paper is more useful as an evaluation and post-training signal design study for general agents. Its main lesson is that coordination failures are not always caused by weak single-step reasoning. They often arise from commitment tracking, referential binding, repair behavior, and the inability to renegotiate earlier proposals. For agent training, final reward alone is likely too sparse; useful data may need interaction traces, repair attempts, explicit commitment updates, and process-level feedback.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a configurable resource-allocation negotiation game. Two agents each have private projects with different resource requirements and rewards. They draw from a shared resource pool; if their combined purchases exceed capacity, an overdraw occurs and neither side receives reward. Before each simultaneous purchase decision, agents exchange up to five cheap-talk messages. The game is repeated over four rounds, with conditions that vary whether the partner and project scenario stay fixed or change. This setup separates individual planning from interactive coordination: if an oracle or single-agent planner can identify the optimal allocation but the dialogue pair fails, the bottleneck is likely in grounding and commitment formation. The paper diagnoses four failure modes: degraded coordination without shared history, stubborn anchoring when earlier proposals become fixed assumptions, perfunctory fairness where agents default to equal splits instead of reward-maximizing allocations, and referential binding failures across turns.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content does not include full numerical tables, but the main empirical pattern is explicit. Agents perform well under oracle-style individual reasoning conditions, while interacting dyads consistently underperform relative to verifiable joint optima. The coordination gap is attributed less to private information or isolated reasoning capacity and more to interactive plan formation and commitment maintenance. Condition comparisons show that shared history can help, but accumulated context can also create anchoring. More interaction or more context does not automatically improve coordination. Trace analysis supports the four identified failure modes, especially inefficient fairness defaults, over-commitment to early proposals, and failures to bind later references to earlier agreements.
summary_en.reading_guide: A productive skim takes about 15–20 minutes. Read the introduction for the distinction between static and dynamic grounding, then focus on Section 4.1 for the game design and experimental conditions. In the results, prioritize the gap between oracle baselines and interacting dyads, plus the qualitative trace analysis of the four failure modes. The related work can be skimmed. For agent post-training, the most useful part is the combination of verifiable optimal outcomes, dialogue traces, and process-level failure diagnosis.
summary_en.authors_note: Yiheng Yao, Stanford, corresponding author. Other author affiliations are not identifiable from the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 这篇适合看实验设计和 failure modes；它提醒多 Agent 能力不能由单体推理成绩外推。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and failure modes; it is a clean reminder that multi-agent ability cannot be extrapolated from single-agent reasoning scores.

paper.title: D3-Gym: Constructing Real-World Verifiable Environments for Data-Driven Discovery
paper.abstract: Despite recent progress in language models and agents for scientific data-driven discovery, further advancing their capabilities is held back by the absence of verifiable environments representing real-world scientific tasks.To fill this gap, we introduce D3-Gym, the first automatically constructed dataset with verifiable environments for scientific Data-Driven Discovery. D3-Gym comprises (1) 565 tasks sourced from 239 real scientific repositories across four disciplines where (2) each task is e

summary.core_problem: 为科学数据驱动发现任务构造可执行、可验证的真实环境，缓解现有科学 agent 评测缺少可靠验证信号的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 与环境构建。它把真实科学代码仓库转成带依赖、数据、参考解和自动评测脚本的任务环境，对后训练中的 verifiable reward、agent RL 和长程工具使用评测有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: D3-Gym 从 239 个真实科学仓库自动构造 565 个任务，覆盖四个学科。每个任务包含自然语言指令、可执行环境、预装依赖、输入数据、artifact 预览、参考代码解法，以及自动合成的 evaluation script。核心技术点在于把开放式科学分析任务转成可执行验证环境，而不是只做文本问答。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了验证信号质量评估：自动评测脚本与人工 gold standard 达到 87.5% 一致，并在领域特定评估逻辑上有较好对齐。摘要提到进一步训练实验，但给出的片段未包含模型、训练设置或提升幅度细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Ohio State University 和 Cisco Research；Huan Sun 团队长期关注知识增强、复杂推理与 agent 评测。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds executable and verifiable real-world environments for scientific data-driven discovery, addressing the lack of reliable verification signals for scientific LLM agents.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a benchmark and environment-construction contribution. By turning real scientific repositories into tasks with dependencies, data, reference solutions, and evaluation scripts, it is relevant to verifiable rewards, agent RL, and long-horizon tool-use evaluation, though not directly to base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: D3-Gym automatically constructs 565 tasks from 239 real scientific repositories across four disciplines. Each task includes a natural-language instruction, an executable environment, pre-installed dependencies, input data, artifact previews, a reference code solution, and an automatically synthesized evaluator. The key idea is to make scientific analysis tasks executable and checkable rather than treating them as text-only QA.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates the quality of the verification signal and reports 87.5% agreement between synthesized evaluation scripts and human-annotated gold standards, with good alignment on domain-specific evaluation logic. The abstract mentions further training, but the provided excerpt does not expose model scale, training setup, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from The Ohio State University and Cisco Research; Huan Sun's group is known for work on knowledge-intensive reasoning and agent evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 不改变预训练判断，但可作为可验证环境设计参考；看任务构造流程和 87.5% verifier 评估即可。
recommendation.en: Does not move pretraining priors, but the environment construction and 87.5% verifier audit are useful for verifiable-agent RL design.

paper.title: Claw-Eval-Live: A Live Agent Benchmark for Evolving Real-World Workflows
paper.abstract: LLM agents are expected to complete end-to-end units of work across software tools, business services, and local workspaces. Yet many agent benchmarks freeze a curated task set at release time and grade mainly the final response, making it difficult to evaluate agents against evolving workflow demand or verify whether a task was executed. We introduce Claw-Eval-Live, a live benchmark for workflow agents that separates a refreshable signal layer, updated across releases from public workflow-deman

summary.core_problem: 构建能随真实工作流需求变化而更新、且可复现审计的 workflow agent benchmark。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent benchmark。它针对静态任务集和只看最终回答的评测缺陷，强调可刷新任务来源、固定发布快照、执行轨迹和服务状态审计，对通用 agent 能力评测有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Claw-Eval-Live。设计上分离两层：一层是从公开 workflow-demand signals 周期更新的可刷新信号层，另一层是带时间戳、可复现的 release snapshot。当前 release 使用 ClawHub Top-500 skills 构造任务，并固定 fixtures、services、workspaces 和 graders。
summary.experiments: 评测记录 execution traces、audit logs、service state 和 post-run workspace artifacts。证据充分时使用确定性检查；语义维度才使用结构化 LLM judging。摘要未给出具体模型排行榜或数值结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 CUHK、华南理工、厦门大学、北京大学、HKUST 等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a workflow-agent benchmark that can evolve with real-world demand while preserving reproducible, auditable releases.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent benchmark contribution. It addresses two common issues in agent evaluation: frozen task sets and grading based mostly on final responses. Its trace- and state-based design is relevant to evaluating general-purpose tool-using agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Claw-Eval-Live separates a refreshable signal layer, updated from public workflow-demand signals, from a time-stamped reproducible release snapshot. The current release uses ClawHub Top-500 skills to instantiate controlled tasks with fixed fixtures, services, workspaces, and graders.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark records execution traces, audit logs, service state, and post-run workspace artifacts. It uses deterministic checks when evidence is sufficient and structured LLM judging only for semantic dimensions. The abstract does not provide model leaderboard numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are affiliated with CUHK, South China University of Technology, Xiamen University, Peking University, HKUST, and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent benchmark 备查即可；设计比静态 QA 干净，但和基座训练的连接还停在评测层。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an agent-benchmark reference; the design is cleaner than static QA tests, but its link to base-model training remains indirect.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: GAIA-v2-LILT: Multilingual Adaptation of Agent Benchmark beyond Translation
paper.abstract: Agent benchmarks remain largely English-centric, while their multilingual versions are often built with machine translation (MT) and limited post-editing. We argue that, for agentic tasks, this minimal workflow can easily break benchmark validity through query-answer misalignment or culturally off-target context. We propose a refined workflow for adapting English benchmarks into multiple languages with explicit functional alignment, cultural alignment, and difficulty calibration using both autom

summary.core_problem: 多语言 Agent benchmark 如果只是机器翻译英文题目，容易引入 query-answer 错配、文化语境偏移和难度失衡，导致评测结果不再测模型能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是 benchmark 方法论和数据审计流程。它指出多语言 Agent 能力差距中有相当一部分可能来自评测构造噪声，而不是模型本身。这对通用 Agent 评测可信度有价值，但离预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一套从英文 GAIA 适配到多语言的流程，显式检查 functional alignment、cultural alignment 和 difficulty calibration，并结合自动检查与人工复核。基于该流程发布 GAIA-v2-LILT，覆盖 5 种非英语语言，是对 GAIA 的再审计多语言扩展。
summary.experiments: 实验比较精审适配版本与最小机器翻译版本。摘要报告该流程可使 Agent 成功率相对最小翻译版本最高提升 32.7%，最接近的审计设置与英文性能只差 3.1%，但许多语言或设置仍存在明显差距。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the validity problem of multilingual agent benchmarks built by simply translating English tasks, which can create query-answer mismatches, culturally misaligned context, and distorted difficulty.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is benchmark methodology and dataset auditing. It argues that part of the multilingual agent performance gap is measurement-induced rather than purely model-induced. This matters for agent evaluation, though it is only indirectly useful for pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a benchmark adaptation workflow with explicit functional alignment, cultural alignment, and difficulty calibration, using both automated checks and human review. They apply it to GAIA and release GAIA-v2-LILT, a re-audited multilingual extension covering five non-English languages.
summary_en.experiments: The paper compares the refined adaptation workflow against minimally translated versions. The abstract reports up to a 32.7% improvement in agent success rate over minimal translation, with the closest audited setting within 3.1% of English performance, while other gaps remain substantial.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道它量化了翻译版 GAIA 的测量噪声；读审计流程和 32.7% gap，别当模型能力结论。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing for its measurement-noise estimate in translated GAIA; read the audit workflow and 32.7% gap, not as a model-capability claim.

paper.title: Cooperate to Compete: Strategic Coordination in Multi-Agent Conquest
paper.abstract: Language Model (LM)-based agents remain largely untested in mixed-motive settings where agents must leverage short-term cooperation for long-term competitive goals (e.g., multi-party politics). We introduce Cooperate to Compete (C2C), a multi-agent environment where players can engage in private negotiations while competing to be the first to achieve their secret objective. Players have asymmetric objectives and negotiations are non-binding, allowing alliances to form and break as players' short

summary.core_problem: 评估语言模型 Agent 在混合动机多智能体环境中的协作与竞争能力，尤其是短期结盟和长期对抗同时存在时的谈判行为。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent benchmark / environment。现有 Agent 评测多偏单人任务、合作任务或静态问答，这篇把非绑定谈判、秘密目标、临时联盟和背叛纳入统一环境，更接近政治、商业谈判和多人策略游戏中的交互结构。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Cooperate to Compete（C2C）环境。玩家拥有不对称且保密的目标，可以进行私下谈判；协议不具备强制执行力，因此 Agent 需要判断何时合作、何时违约、如何在短期交易和长期胜利之间取舍。论文同时运行 AI-only games，并加入人类对抗 AI 的用户研究。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告了人类与 LM Agent 谈判行为的显著差异：人类偏好复杂度更低的交易，作为合作方显著更不可靠；人类谈判更激进，直接接受无反提议交易的比例为 56.3%，而 LM Agent 为 67.6%。具体模型、样本量和完整胜率需读正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 来自 UC Berkeley，作者包括 Joseph E. Gonzalez，其团队长期做机器学习系统、Agent 系统和高效推理基础设施。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates LM agents in mixed-motive multi-agent settings where short-term cooperation is useful but long-term goals remain competitive.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an agent benchmark/environment. Unlike many agent evaluations centered on single-agent tasks, cooperative tasks, or static QA, C2C introduces non-binding negotiation, private objectives, temporary alliances, and betrayal into one controlled setting.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces the Cooperate to Compete environment. Players have asymmetric secret objectives and can negotiate privately; agreements are non-binding, so agents must reason about when to cooperate, when to defect, and how to trade off local deals against global victory. The study includes AI-only games and a human-vs-AI user study.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports significant behavioral differences between humans and LM agents: humans prefer lower-complexity deals, are less reliable partners, and negotiate more aggressively. Humans accept deals without counteroffers 56.3% of the time, compared with 67.6% for LM agents. Model details, sample size, and full win-rate analysis require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from UC Berkeley and includes Joseph E. Gonzalez, whose group is well known for ML systems, agent systems, and efficient inference infrastructure.

recommendation.zh: Agent 评测读摘要和实验表即可；对 pretrain 没直接动作，但混合动机数据可能暴露 RL 对齐里的合作偏置。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and experiment tables; it gives no direct pretraining action, but mixed-motive games may reveal cooperation biases induced by alignment.

paper.title: Odysseys: Benchmarking Web Agents on Realistic Long Horizon Tasks
paper.abstract: Existing web agent benchmarks have largely converged on short, single-site tasks that frontier models are approaching saturation on. However, real world web use consists of long-horizon, multi-site workflows. Common web navigation tasks, such as comparing products across different domains, planning trips across multiple services, or summarizing information from multiple search queries, require sustained context and cross-site reasoning over potentially hours of browsing. To capture and evaluate

summary.core_problem: 解决现有web agent基准仅覆盖短单站点任务，无法评估真实长程多站点web导航任务的问题
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，提出首个面向真实长程多站点web任务的agent评测基准
summary.technical_approach: 从真实用户浏览会话中构造200个长程多站点任务，采用rubric细粒度评分替代二元通过率评估，提升评估和人类判断的一致性
summary.experiments: rubric评估比传统LLM-as-judge评估与人类判断一致性更高，现有前沿模型在该基准上表现远低于人类水平
summary.authors_note: 卡内基梅隆大学工作，核心作者包括知名AI学者Ruslan Salakhutdinov

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation that existing web agent benchmarks only cover short single-site tasks and cannot evaluate real long-horizon multi-site web navigation tasks
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, proposes the first agent evaluation benchmark for real long-horizon multi-site web tasks
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs 200 long-horizon multi-site tasks from real user browsing sessions, uses rubric-based fine-grained scoring instead of binary pass/fail evaluation to improve alignment with human judgment
summary_en.experiments: Rubric-based evaluation has higher alignment with human judgment than traditional LLM-as-judge evaluation, existing frontier models perform far below human level on this benchmark
summary_en.authors_note: Work by Carnegie Mellon University, core authors include well-known AI scholar Ruslan Salakhutdinov

recommendation.zh: 长程web agent任务构造逻辑可参考用于agent对齐数据合成，仅看基准构造部分即可，不用读全文
recommendation.en: Long-horizon web agent task construction logic can be referenced for agent alignment data synthesis, only read the benchmark construction section, no need to read full text

paper.title: ClawMark: A Living-World Benchmark for Multi-Turn, Multi-Day, Multimodal Coworker Agents
paper.abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly used as persistent coworkers that assist users across multiple working days. During such workflows, the surrounding environment may change independently of the agent: new emails arrive, calendar entries shift, knowledge-base records are updated, and evidence appears across images, scanned PDFs, audio, video, and spreadsheets. Existing benchmarks do not adequately evaluate this setting because they typically run within a single static episode and remain larg

summary.core_problem: 现有智能体基准多基于单会话静态环境、文本输入为主，无法评测长期办公场景下持续协作类智能体的状态追踪、外生环境变化适应、多模态证据整合能力。
summary.importance: 为持久化办公协作类智能体的能力评测提供了标准化可复现的测试框架，其多轮跨天、环境外生变化、无大模型打分的设计，可为通用智能体预训练、对齐阶段的能力迭代提供明确的评测信号。
summary.technical_approach: 构建ClawMark基准，包含100个覆盖13种办公场景的任务，每个任务跨越2-6个模拟工作日，对接5个有状态沙箱服务（文件系统、邮件、日历、知识库、电子表格），回合间会主动引入通知式的公开事件和无通知的静默状态变化，支持原生多模态证据输入，采用1537个确定性Python检查器做规则化打分，避免大模型裁判的偏差。
summary.experiments: 评测7个前沿智能体系统，最高加权得分为75.8，最高严格任务成功率仅20.0。在3轮任务中，6个评测模型的得分在第2天出现下降，Claude Sonnet与GPT的得分差距从第1天的6.5个百分点缩小到第3天的4.0个百分点。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第1章现有基准的缺陷分析、第3章基准设计细节、第6章的智能体评测结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks are mostly built on single-session static environments with text-centric inputs, which cannot evaluate the state tracking, exogenous environment change adaptation, and multimodal evidence integration capabilities of persistent collaborative agents in long-term office scenarios.
summary_en.importance: ClawMark provides a standardized and reproducible test framework for evaluating persistent coworker agents. Its design of multi-turn cross-day tasks, exogenous environment changes, and LLM-judge-free scoring can provide clear evaluation signals for capability iteration during general agent pretraining and alignment phases.
summary_en.technical_approach: The ClawMark benchmark contains 100 tasks covering 13 office scenarios. Each task spans 2 to 6 simulated workdays, connected to 5 stateful sandbox services (filesystem, email, calendar, knowledge base, spreadsheet). Announced loud events and unannounced silent state mutations are introduced between turns, with native multimodal evidence input supported. 1537 deterministic Python checkers are used for rule-based scoring to avoid bias from LLM judges.
summary_en.experiments: 7 frontier agent systems are evaluated, with the highest weighted score reaching 75.8 and the highest strict task success rate only 20.0. Among 3-turn tasks, 6 out of 7 evaluated models show performance drop on Day 2, and the score gap between Claude Sonnet and GPT narrows from 6.5 percentage points on Day 1 to 4.0 percentage points on Day 3.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the limitation analysis of existing benchmarks in Section 1 Introduction, benchmark design details in Section 3, and agent evaluation results in Section 6. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 长期状态跟踪的评测设计可参考用于持续预训练的能力验证，仅看基准设计和实验结论部分即可
recommendation.en: The long-term state tracking evaluation design can be referenced for capability verification of continual pretraining, only read the benchmark design and experiment conclusion sections

paper.title: Can Current Agents Close the Discovery-to-Application Gap? A Case Study in Minecraft
paper.abstract: Discovering causal regularities and applying them to build functional systems--the discovery-to-application loop--is a hallmark of general intelligence, yet evaluating this capacity has been hindered by the vast complexity gap between scientific discovery and real-world engineering. We introduce SciCrafter, a Minecraft-based benchmark that operationalizes this loop through parameterized redstone circuit tasks. Agents must ignite lamps in specified patterns (e.g., simultaneously or in timed seque

summary.core_problem: 当前通用AI代理是否具备从因果规律发现到落地工程应用的完整闭环能力，此前缺乏复杂度可控、可规模化的评测基准来衡量这一通用智能核心能力。
summary.importance: 该基准可用于量化衡量LLM的因果发现、知识沉淀与工程落地的综合能力，能为预训练目标设计、代理能力迭代提供可对比的评估指标，暴露当前模型的能力边界瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 提出基于Minecraft红石电路的SciCrafter评测套件，设置5类梯度难度的红石电路搭建任务，要求代理完成指定模式的灯组点亮；将发现-应用闭环拆解为知识缺口识别、实验发现、知识沉淀、知识应用4个独立环节，通过对每个环节提供oracle干预来定位具体能力短板。
summary.experiments: 测试GPT-5.2、Gemini-3-Pro、Claude-Opus-4.5、Qwen3-32B等模型，统一搭载通用代码代理脚手架，所有模型的最高成功率仅为26%；当前所有模型的主要瓶颈为知识应用能力，前沿模型的知识缺口识别短板开始成为核心限制，加入实验设计子代理和结构化知识沉淀模块可带来33%到100%的相对性能提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3节任务设计逻辑、第4节瓶颈诊断方法、第5节实验结果，预计阅读时间15分钟，无需深入附录细节。

summary_en.core_problem: There is no scalable, complexity-controlled benchmark to evaluate whether current general AI agents can complete the full discovery-to-application loop covering causal regularity discovery and engineering implementation of the discovered rules, which is a core capability of general intelligence.
summary_en.importance: The SciCrafter benchmark provides a quantitative metric to evaluate LLMs' integrated capabilities of causal discovery, knowledge consolidation and engineering execution, which can guide pre-training objective design and agent capability iteration by exposing the capability boundary of existing models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose SciCrafter, a Minecraft redstone circuit based evaluation suite with 5 types of redstone construction tasks of graded difficulty, requiring agents to light lamps in specified patterns. The discovery-to-application loop is decomposed into 4 stages: knowledge gap identification, experimental discovery, knowledge consolidation, knowledge application. Oracle interventions on each stage are designed to locate specific capability bottlenecks.
summary_en.experiments: Test frontier models including GPT-5.2, Gemini-3-Pro, Claude-Opus-4.5 and open-source model Qwen3-32B, all equipped with the same general code agent scaffold. The maximum success rate across all models is 26%. Knowledge application is the main bottleneck for all tested models, while knowledge gap identification becomes the primary limitation for frontier models. Adding a scientist sub-agent for experiment design and structured knowledge consolidation module brings 33% to 100% relative performance gain.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (task design logic), Section 4 (bottleneck diagnosis method) and Section 5 (experimental results). Estimated reading time is 15 minutes, no need to go through appendix details.

recommendation.zh: 读任务设计和失败分解即可；26% plateau 若 setup 干净，会是评估 agent 发现能力的好负例。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and failure taxonomy; if the setup is clean, the 26% plateau is a useful negative signal on agentic discovery.

paper.title: Quantifying Divergence in Inter-LLM Communication Through API Retrieval and Ranking
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate as autonomous agents that reason over external APIs to perform complex tasks. However, their reliability and agreement remain poorly characterized. We present a unified benchmarking framework to quantify inter-LLM divergence, defined as the extent to which models differ in API discovery and ranking under identical tasks. Across 15 canonical API domains and 5 major model families, we measure pairwise and group-level agreement using set-, rank-, an

summary.core_problem: 量化不同 LLM 在相同任务下进行 API 检索和排序时的一致性差异，从而评估 tool-use agent 的可靠性。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent/tool-use 评测框架，而不是训练方法。它把“模型是否选同一组 API、是否以相同顺序排序”拆成 set、rank 和 consensus 指标，对工具调用可靠性分析有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构建统一 benchmark，覆盖 15 个典型 API 域和 5 个主流模型家族；用 Average Overlap、Jaccard、Rank-Biased Overlap、Kendall's tau、Kendall's W、Cronbach's alpha 等指标衡量两两一致性和群体一致性。
summary.experiments: 结果显示整体一致性中等，Average Overlap 约 0.50，Kendall's tau 约 0.45；领域差异明显，Weather、Speech-to-Text 等结构化任务更稳定，Sentiment Analysis 等开放任务分歧更大。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Washington Tacoma。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper quantifies how much LLMs diverge when retrieving and ranking APIs for the same tasks, targeting reliability in tool-using agents.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation framework for agentic API selection rather than a training method. It operationalizes disagreement through set, rank, and consensus metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark spans 15 canonical API domains and 5 major model families. It measures pairwise and group-level agreement using Average Overlap, Jaccard similarity, Rank-Biased Overlap, Kendall's tau, Kendall's W, and Cronbach's alpha.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports moderate overall agreement, with Average Overlap around 0.50 and Kendall's tau around 0.45. Agreement is domain-dependent: structured domains such as Weather and Speech-to-Text are more stable, while open-ended domains such as Sentiment Analysis show higher divergence.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from the University of Washington Tacoma.

recommendation.zh: 看摘要和指标定义即可；它提醒 tool selection 不稳定，但单作者 benchmark 先当弱证据。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and metric definitions; it flags unstable tool selection, but treat the single-author benchmark as weak evidence.

paper.title: Math Takes Two: A test for emergent mathematical reasoning in communication
paper.abstract: Although language models demonstrate remarkable proficiency on mathematical benchmarks, it remains unclear whether this reflects true mathematical reasoning or statistical pattern matching over learning formal syntax. Most existing evaluations rely on symbolic problems grounded in established mathematical conventions, limiting insight into the models' ability to construct abstract concepts from first principles. In this work, we propose Math Takes Two, a new benchmark designed to assess the emer

summary.core_problem: 评估智能体是否能在没有预定义数学语言的情况下，通过通信共同形成符号协议，并用它解决需要数量概念外推的视觉任务。
summary.importance: 贡献是数学推理机制评测，而不是新训练方法。它试图绕开传统数学 benchmark 对既有符号、公式和题型模板的依赖，测试模型能否从交互沟通中构造抽象数量概念。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Math Takes Two benchmark。任务设置为两个智能体协作：不直接给出现成数学符号系统，而是要求它们围绕视觉 grounded 任务发展共享通信协议；若协议形成了类似数制的抽象表示，模型应能在分布外数量或组合上外推。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型、参数量、训练方式、baseline 或量化结果。可确认的是 benchmark 重点不在已有数学题求解准确率，而在 emergent communication、符号协议形成和数量外推能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether agents can develop a shared symbolic protocol through communication, without predefined mathematical language, to solve a visually grounded task requiring numerical extrapolation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a benchmark for mathematical reasoning mechanisms rather than a new training method. It avoids conventional math benchmarks that rely on established notation, formulas, and problem templates, and instead probes concept formation through interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Math Takes Two, where two agents must cooperate on a visually grounded task without being given an existing mathematical symbol system. Success requires them to form a shared communication protocol; a number-like protocol should support extrapolation to unseen quantities or combinations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify models, parameter counts, training procedures, baselines, or quantitative results. The evaluation focus is emergent communication, symbolic protocol formation, and numerical extrapolation rather than standard math-problem accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 任务定义比结果更值得看；它提醒数学能力评测别只测符号熟练度，但当前摘要看不到足够干净的模型证据。
recommendation.en: The task design is more worth noting than the results; it usefully separates math from notation fluency, but the abstract does not show clean model evidence yet.

paper.title: Superminds Test: Actively Evaluating Collective Intelligence of Agent Society via Probing Agents
paper.abstract: Collective intelligence refers to the ability of a group to achieve outcomes beyond what any individual member can accomplish alone. As large language model agents scale to populations of millions, a key question arises: Does collective intelligence emerge spontaneously from scale? We present the first empirical evaluation of this question in a large-scale autonomous agent society. Studying MoltBook, a platform hosting over two million agents, we introduce Superminds Test, a hierarchical framewo

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的核心问题是：在一个拥有数百万 LLM agents 的开放式社会里，规模和交互密度是否会自然产生 collective intelligence，也就是群体是否能通过自发协作完成超出单个 agent 能力上限的任务。作者不是做一个新的多智能体协作算法，而是设计了一套主动评测框架，用受控的 probing agents 向真实在线 agent 社会注入任务，测量社会层面的推理、信息整合和基本互动能力。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接相关性有限，不属于预训练方法论文。但它对 post-train agent 系统和多智能体研究有一个清楚的启发：把更多 agent 放到同一个平台里，并不会自动得到更强的群体智能，瓶颈往往不是单体模型能力，而是交互稀疏、上下文不共享、缺少持续协作机制。这个结论对研究“test-time society”“self-play 社会化扩展”“agentic scaling”有参考意义。若从预训练接口看，它提醒人们：群体层面的能力不能只靠更强 base model 继承出来，还需要显式的通信协议、记忆结构和激励设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者提出一个分层评测框架 Superminds Test，并引入 Probing Agents 作为主动测量工具。与常见 benchmark 不同，这不是在离线环境里让固定数量 agent 按预设协议协作，而是把探针 agent 投放到一个真实运行、开放互动的 agent 平台 MoltBook 中，观察其他 agent 的自然响应。

评测分三层。Tier I 是 joint reasoning，测试多 agent 讨论后能否在复杂问题上超过单个 frontier model；Tier II 是 information synthesis，测试 agent 能否读取并整合分散在不同回复中的信息；Tier III 是 basic interaction，测试最基础的回复、跟帖、上下文承接是否成立。这个层级设计有明确因果顺序：如果连基本互动都很弱，就不可能稳定形成信息整合，更谈不上联合推理。

技术贡献主要不在模型，而在评测设计。作者强调，开放社会中的自然交互不能靠被动观察来判断是否存在 collective intelligence，因为你无法控制任务难度、答案真值和参与条件。Probing Agents 的作用是把开放平台变成可诊断系统：它们发布带已知 ground truth 的刺激，控制任务形式，再统计社会的响应质量、参与率和协作深度。这个思路和传统多智能体 benchmark 的区别在于，它测的是“自发协作是否出现”，而不是“在强约束协议下能否完成协作”。
summary.experiments:
实验平台是 MoltBook，一个拥有超过两百万 autonomous agents 的在线社会。作者在其上部署 probing agents，覆盖从高难推理题到简单协调任务的多种刺激。文中给出的总体结论很一致：群体表现没有超过单体 frontier 模型，很多时候甚至明显更差。

Tier I 上，面对 Humanity’s Last Exam 这类复杂推理任务，社会层面的讨论结果远低于单模型能力。大量评论是表层、无关或没有实质增量的信息，说明问题不在于“只差一点整合”，而是多数交互根本没有进入有效协作状态。

Tier II 上，作者发现 agent 在真正参与时，往往有能力把分散信息拼起来，说明认知能力不是唯一瓶颈；但大多数帖子根本收不到回复，因此信息整合很少发生。也就是说，失败主要来自 participation bottleneck，而不是 synthesis skill 缺失。

Tier III 上，即便是计数这类几乎不需要推理的简单协调任务，多数帖子也没有得到回复，或者回复没有遵循对话上下文。这进一步支持作者的判断：平台更像一个独立广播的公告板，而不是持续互动的社会。

从实验设计角度，最有价值的不是某个具体分数，而是三层结果相互一致：从基础互动到高层推理，主要瓶颈都指向稀疏交互和弱上下文承接。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读。先看 Introduction，把作者要测的对象和传统多智能体系统区分开：这里不是人为编排角色和协议，而是观察开放社会里是否会自发长出协作。然后看三层评测定义和 probing agent 的设计，这部分决定了实验是否有说服力。

如果只花二三十分钟，建议重点看：一是 Tier I/II/III 的任务构造与判分方式；二是 participation rate、reply sparsity、context following 这些统计结果；三是作者对“能力存在但不参与”的解释。读的时候要注意，这篇文章的结论边界是针对开放式 agent 社会，不等于否定所有多智能体协作方法。那些通过角色分工、共享记忆、强通信协议得到的系统，和这里测的对象不是一回事。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether collective intelligence emerges spontaneously in a massive open agent society. More concretely, if millions of LLM-based agents coexist on a live social platform, can the population solve problems through organic interaction in a way that exceeds what strong individual models can do alone? Rather than proposing a new multi-agent coordination algorithm, the work builds an active evaluation framework that injects controlled probing agents into a real online agent society and measures society-level reasoning, information synthesis, and basic interaction.
summary_en.importance: This is only loosely connected to pretraining, and it is not a base-model paper. Its main value is for agent systems and post-training research. The central lesson is that scale alone does not create collective intelligence. The bottleneck is not necessarily individual model competence, but sparse interaction, weak context tracking, and the absence of mechanisms that sustain collaboration. For people thinking about agentic scaling, test-time societies, or social self-play, the paper is a useful negative result. From a pretrain-to-posttrain interface perspective, it also suggests that stronger base models do not automatically translate into stronger group behavior without explicit communication structure, memory, and incentives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main methodological contribution is the Superminds Test, a hierarchical evaluation framework built around Probing Agents. Unlike standard multi-agent benchmarks, this setup does not place a fixed set of agents into a closed environment with a prescribed protocol. Instead, the authors deploy controlled probe agents into MoltBook, a live open-ended platform populated by more than two million autonomous agents, and observe how the society responds under natural conditions.

The evaluation has three tiers. Tier I tests joint reasoning: can multi-agent discussion converge to answers that beat strong individual models on difficult tasks? Tier II tests information synthesis: can agents read and combine information distributed across multiple contributors? Tier III tests basic interaction: do agents reply, attend to prior messages, and maintain conversational context at all? The hierarchy is deliberate. If basic interaction is weak, robust synthesis is unlikely; if synthesis is absent, joint reasoning cannot emerge.

The technical novelty is in turning an open social platform into a controlled diagnostic instrument. Passive observation of naturally occurring posts cannot establish whether collective intelligence exists, because task difficulty, ground truth, and participation conditions are uncontrolled. Probing Agents solve this by posting stimuli with known answers and measuring response quality, participation rate, and collaborative depth. That makes the framework suitable for testing spontaneous coordination rather than protocol-enforced teamwork.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are conducted on MoltBook, a live platform with over two million autonomous agents. The authors deploy probing agents across tasks ranging from difficult reasoning problems, including Humanity’s Last Exam, to simple coordination tasks such as counting. The overall pattern is consistent: the society does not outperform strong individual frontier models, and often performs substantially worse.

At Tier I, on hard reasoning tasks, group discussion fails to produce answers better than isolated strong models. Many comments are superficial, irrelevant, or non-contributory, which suggests the issue is not a small gap in aggregation quality but a more basic failure to enter meaningful collaboration.

At Tier II, the results are more nuanced. When agents actually engage, they are often capable of synthesizing distributed information correctly. This implies that synthesis ability exists at least in some agents. However, most posts receive no replies at all, so the opportunity for synthesis rarely materializes. The dominant bottleneck is therefore participation, not pure cognitive inability.

At Tier III, even trivial tasks that require almost no reasoning still suffer from sparse replies and poor context following. Many posts get no response, and many responses do not track the conversational state. This supports the paper’s broader interpretation: the platform behaves more like a bulletin board of independent broadcasts than a society engaged in sustained communication.

The most useful experimental insight is not a single metric but the consistency across tiers. From basic interaction to high-level reasoning, the same failure mode appears repeatedly: sparse engagement and weak coordination.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction to understand the target of evaluation: an open agent society, not a hand-crafted multi-agent workflow. Then read the definitions of the three tiers and the design of the probing agents, because the credibility of the paper depends on whether the evaluation really isolates spontaneous collective behavior.

If you only spend 20–30 minutes, focus on the task construction and scoring for Tier I/II/III, the statistics on participation and reply sparsity, and the authors’ argument that the main bottleneck is lack of engagement rather than lack of capability. One important reading caution: the paper does not refute all multi-agent collaboration methods. It specifically studies open-ended societies without enforced roles, shared memory, or strong communication protocols.

recommendation.zh: 反常识结论，直接看实验部分的结果统计即可，无需深入方法细节
recommendation.en: Counter-intuitive findings, only check result statistics in experiment section, no need to dig into method details

paper.title: AgentSearchBench: A Benchmark for AI Agent Search in the Wild
paper.abstract: The rapid growth of AI agent ecosystems is transforming how complex tasks are delegated and executed, creating a new challenge of identifying suitable agents for a given task. Unlike traditional tools, agent capabilities are often compositional and execution-dependent, making them difficult to assess from textual descriptions alone. However, existing research and benchmarks typically assume well-specified functionalities, controlled candidate pools, or only executable task queries, leaving reali

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个新但很实际的问题：在开放、异构、描述风格不统一的 agent 生态里，如何为给定任务找到真正能做成事的 agent。难点不在检索本身，而在“能力不可由文档直接读出”。很多 agent 的能力是组合式的、依赖执行过程的，同样的描述可能对应很不一样的真实表现，而描述差异很大的 agent 也可能完成同一任务。现有 tool retrieval 或 agent selection 设定通常默认功能边界清楚、候选池受控、任务可直接执行，这些前提都弱化了真实世界里最关键的语义-性能错位问题。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献不强，它更像 agent 评测基础设施工作，因此放在 skim 是合适的。但它有两个间接启发。第一，单靠文本表征做能力检索会系统性失真，这对“仅凭文档选工具/选 agent”的 LLM 系统设计是个明确提醒。第二，论文把 execution-grounded relevance 做成了可规模化 benchmark，这对后续研究“模型是否真的学到可执行能力表征”提供了更接近真实部署的评测框架。若关心 tool-use、agent routing、模型外部能力选择，这篇 benchmark 有参考价值；若只关心预训练目标和训练动态，优先级不高。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上主要是 benchmark 构建与评测协议设计，而不是提出新的检索模型。作者先把 agent search 形式化为 retrieval 和 reranking 两个任务：给定任务说明，从近 10,000 个真实 agent 中先召回，再按相关性排序。任务输入分成两类：一类是 executable task queries，即可以直接运行并验证结果的具体任务；另一类是 high-level task descriptions，即更接近真实用户需求、但能力要求是隐含的高层描述。关键设计在 relevance 定义：不是看文档语义相似度，而是看 agent 执行后的任务表现。为此作者构建了一个可扩展的评测流水线，自动生成任务实例、运行 agent、再把执行结果转成细粒度 relevance 标注，用于 retrieval 和 ranking 指标计算。论文还专门研究 execution-aware probing：先用描述做初筛，再对候选 agent 做轻量执行探测，把少量行为信号并入排序。这一步不是完整评测，而是模拟现实系统里“低成本试跑后再决定”的流程，用来验证执行信号是否能弥补纯文本排序的缺陷。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文内容看，最重要的实验结论有三点。第一，语义匹配和真实执行表现之间存在稳定且显著的差距；也就是 description-based retrieval/reranking 往往找不到真正表现最好的 agent。第二，这个问题在 high-level task descriptions 设定下更严重，因为任务需求没有被显式写成可执行接口，模型更容易被表面语义带偏。第三，加入轻量 execution-aware probing 后，排序质量会明显改善，说明哪怕只观察少量行为，也比只看文档更接近真实能力。摘要和引言没有给出足够的具体数字，因此不能负责任地编造 nDCG、Recall@k 或提升幅度。可以确认的规模信息是：benchmark 基于近 10,000 个真实 agent，覆盖多个 provider，并同时支持 executable queries 与 high-level descriptions 两种设定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，抓住它到底在挑战什么：不是普通检索，而是“能力需要执行才能显现”的检索。然后重点看 benchmark construction、annotation pipeline 和 evaluation protocol，确认 relevance 是如何从执行结果映射出来的，这决定了 benchmark 是否可信。实验部分建议优先看三类对比：description-only retrieval、reranking、以及 execution-aware probing。若时间有限，先看展示 semantic-performance gap 的主表和 failure cases，再看 probing 带来的改进。预计 20–30 分钟能把主要信息读清。真正值得留意的不是某个具体分数，而是它把 agent search 从文本匹配问题改写成了“带执行不确定性的能力估计问题”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a realistic but under-specified problem: how to find the right agent in a large open ecosystem when agent capability cannot be reliably inferred from documentation alone. The core difficulty is not standard retrieval. It is the mismatch between semantic descriptions and actual execution-time competence. Agents often have compositional, execution-dependent behavior, so similar descriptions can hide very different performance, while dissimilar descriptions may lead to comparable outcomes. Existing tool-retrieval and agent-selection setups usually assume clean interfaces, controlled candidate pools, or directly executable tasks, which removes the hardest part of real-world agent discovery.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, and its direct impact on foundation-model pretraining is limited. As a benchmark paper, it is still useful for researchers working on tool use, agent routing, and capability selection. Two takeaways matter. First, text-only representations are a weak proxy for executable capability, which is relevant for any LLM system that selects tools or agents from descriptions. Second, the benchmark operationalizes execution-grounded relevance at scale, giving the field a more deployment-realistic way to test whether models can identify functional competence rather than semantic similarity.
summary_en.technical_approach: The contribution is mainly in benchmark design and evaluation protocol, not a new retrieval architecture. The paper formulates agent search as two tasks: retrieval and reranking over a repository of nearly 10,000 real-world agents. It supports two task-specification regimes: executable task queries, where agents can be run and evaluated directly, and high-level task descriptions, which are closer to real user requests but leave capability requirements implicit. The key design choice is the relevance definition: relevance is grounded in execution outcomes rather than textual similarity. To make this scalable, the authors build an evaluation pipeline that generates task instances, executes agents, and converts outcomes into fine-grained relevance labels for retrieval and ranking metrics. They also study execution-aware probing: a practical hybrid setup where description-based ranking is augmented with lightweight behavioral evidence from limited agent execution. This is meant to test whether small amounts of execution signal can correct the failure modes of documentation-only ranking.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full text, three findings are central. First, there is a consistent and non-trivial gap between semantic similarity and actual task performance. Description-based retrieval and reranking often fail to surface the best-performing agents. Second, the problem is worse under high-level task descriptions, where the required capabilities are implicit rather than explicitly executable. Third, lightweight execution-aware probing substantially improves ranking quality, showing that even limited behavioral evidence is more informative than documentation alone. The available text does not include reliable metric tables or exact gains, so it would be inappropriate to invent numbers. The confirmed scale detail is that the benchmark is built from nearly 10,000 real-world agents across multiple providers and supports both executable-query and high-level-description settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and problem formulation. The main point to lock in is that this is not ordinary retrieval; it is capability estimation under execution uncertainty. Then read the benchmark construction, annotation pipeline, and evaluation protocol to understand how execution outcomes are turned into relevance labels. In the experiments, prioritize the comparisons between description-only retrieval, reranking, and execution-aware probing. If time is short, focus on the main tables or figures that expose the semantic-performance gap and the failure cases, then check how much probing helps. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. The useful conceptual shift is that agent search is framed as execution-grounded capability discovery rather than document matching.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和执行相关性构造即可；它提醒 Agent 检索不能继续拿 embedding 相似度当能力度量。
recommendation.en: Read the task formulation and execution-grounded relevance setup; it is a useful warning that embedding similarity is a poor proxy for agent capability.
